scytalis.name: Scytalis
scytalis.species: Human mutate (Russian Super-Soldier; later corrupted by the Chronoserpent
scytalis.first_appearance: Marvel Realm of Champions: Elegy Season 1 2
scytalis.origin: ===Origin=== Black Widow was infected by the Chronoserpent, transforming her into Scytalis. ===Elegy=== Scytalis was present alongside Bahamet when Anathi was taken to the Chronoserpent by Glykhan. She then witnessed Anathi receiving the Infinity Claw from Black Panther and using it to free herself from the Chronoserpent. ===Contest of Champions: Book 2=== At some point following the destruction of Battleworld, Scytalis worked with Ouroboros. Under the guise of Black Widow, she infiltrated the Avengers and wedged them against Carina Tivan. While on an investigation, Civil Warrior decrypted information from an Ouroboros bunker that someone named Scytalis had infiltrated the Avengers. Without any leads as to who it could be, Carina conjured a plan to draw out Scytalis by having the Summoner and Civil Warrior stand in as Captain America and Iron Man respectively. Leading the disguised duo to a safe room in Avengers Tower, Carina warned them of a traitor among the Avengers. Upon Carina's exit, the tower's security systems went haywire and sealed the safe room from the rest of the building, locking "Captain America" and "Iron Man" inside. Black Widow revealed herself to them and her intent to splinter the Avengers by staging their two founding leaders killing each other. When the illusion around the Summoner and Civil Warrior fizzled away, Scytalis shed her disguise and retaliated. The safe room was breached open as the rest of the Avengers and Carina witnessed Scytalis' defeat against the Summoner. As a final gambit, Scytalis self-destructed and blew up the room but was thwarted by Civil Warrior, who used a protective field to save everyone.

scythian algurus.name: Scythian Algurus
scythian algurus.origin: Scythian was a remorseless and destructive deity of the planet Dartayus in the Negative Zone. At one point in Dartayus' early history, he was magically turned into stone. The area around his body became the Kavangian Plateau, holy ground to his followers, at the emplacement of the Temple of Scythian. Scythian's true nature and fate was confined to ancient text while more modern holy books apparently presented him was a much more remorseful presence. His religion became long-dead, and he was known as the Fallen God until, in modern times, dissident Kologoth Antares preached about him in order to obtain followers for himself. The Temple of Scythian served as headquarters to Kologoth's Dartayus Union. After studying more about Scythian through the ancient texts, Kologoth learned of a way to set him free from his imprisonment, and set out to do so to use Scythian as the instrument of vengeance against the world that made him an outcast. Kologoth's forces were in the middle of a battle against the X-Men when Scythian was awaken and began to rampage through Dartayus. Since magic was no longer in use in the planet, there was no way to turn him back into stone. Instead, the X-Men used a ship to tow Scythian into the deadly vortex located in the center of the Negative Zone, ridding of him. Scythian's restrainment was short-lived, and he eventually escaped from the vortex. Fueled by a thirst for revenge against the X-Men, Scythian ripped a hole in the fabric of the Negative Zone and emerged in the space between Jupiter and Saturn. He made his way to Earth and landed on Paris. Captain Britain and Meggan engaged the creature before the X-Men arrived to the scene. Most of the heroes attacked Scythian with the intent to weaken him while Magik conjured a stepping disc to send him to Limbo. Scythian was finally defeated when Kitty Pryde crashed the Blackbird into his back, and the strength of the impact pushed him into Magik's portal.

sea leopard.name: Sea Leopard
sea leopard.origin: Sea Leopard is a Lemurian from a telepathic sect known as the Ancients that resided in Antarctica. The Sea Leopard came into conflict with Namor the Sub-Mariner over the contents of a sunken ship called the Endurance. Sir Ernest Shackleton led an expedition to the South Pole and landed himself in a place called Palmer Land where he discovered a mysterious ore that caused metals to liquefy. Shackleton and the crew loaded the ship with the anti-metal for roughly about 281 days until the large quantities of metal began to melt the metal structures on the ship. Shackleton and his men abandoned ship and the Endurance sank underneath the ice. Sea Leopard then found the sunken ship and tried to keep the valuable ore as his property. Namor later learned that Leon McKenzie, the grandson of Leonard McKenzie started an expedition to the South Pole to find the missing ship and its precious cargo. Phoebe Marrs explained to the Sub-Mariner that she had also sent another expedition to look for the Endurance as well. Namor warns Phoebe that expedition is in danger because Attuma and his barbarian horde were residing within the city of Old Atlantis near the Endurance's location. Namor and Andromeda travel to Antarctica to stop Leon McKenzie from recovering the contents of the ship. Andromeda travels to Old Atlantis and calls out her father Attuma. Attuma appears from the shadows but collapses in front of her, it is then revealed that he was taken down by Sea Leopard. Namor finds the ship but the Sea Leopard appears holding the bodies of Andromeda and Attuma. Namor then launches towards the Sea Leopard, who used to telepathy to predict Namor's next move in the battle. Namor tries to use his own telepathy to control a Killer Whale to drag him down into the icy depths. Then Leon McKenzie who was then disguised as the Black Moray found the ship, but was also approached by the Sea Leopard. Black Moray's suit was able to block Sea Leopard's telepathy so as a compromise he tells McKenzie that he can get the anti-metal as long as he can make Namor to bow down and work for him as his lifelong slave. Attuma and Andromeda then awoke and attacked the Sea Leopard themselves while Namor confronted Black Moray. During the battle with Namor, Black Moray set off a giant explosion on the ship. Sea Leopard beat Attuma and his daughter in combat again. Black Moray tells the Sea Leopard that the ship was destroyed and Namor had been killed. It was then revealed that Namor was wearing the Black Moray's suit and was able to get close enough to Sea Leopard to strike him. Andromeda and Attuma then help Namor in take down Sea Leopard. Attuma tells Namor that his barbarians would find a suitable punishment for Sea Leopard. Sea Leopard would appear sometime later with the Fathom Five. In an attempt to destroy all surface life the team attack New York. They attack and lash out any one they meet in the streets. The Thunderbolts counteract the team and after a long battle are defeated and retreat into the ocean. The team was defeated and Llyron was nearly killed by the Radioactive Man. They escape and returned to Atlantis, only to discover that he had radiation poisoning, and furthermore, had spread the poisoning among the Atlantean population.

seamus mellencamp.name: Seamus Mellencamp
seamus mellencamp.origin: ===Acolytes=== Mellencamp was a mutant who had to deal with a lot of hardships because of his reptilian appearance. Not long after his mutant powers manifested, Mellencamp was recruited as an Acolyte for Fabian Cortez, who taught him the ways of Magneto, who was believed dead at the time but was really in hiding. Before Magneto could rejoin the newly formed Acolytes, Mellencamp proceeded to take part in a siege on a new Sentinel warehouse, where the Acolytes were attacked by X-Factor. Mellencamp was killed by Multiple Man after he created a new dupe inside him, forcing Mellencamp to burst open. sean benard.name: Sean Benard
sean benard.origin: Sean Benard worked as a police officer at the Vancouver Police Department. Sean was in a very sticky situation when he met the man named Logan. He had just gunned down two of his fellow officers who had turned crooked, using the last of his bullets and was faced with the third who had a shotgun. Logan took out the gunman without killing him and escorted Sean to Ottawa, where he woke the Prime Minister and had him draft Sean into the Canadian secret service. Sean was escorted to the Flight Ranch where he met some rather unusual people and underwent extensive training by Dr Langkowski, until he finally met James Hudson and found out why he was there. He had been recruited as a member of Canada's official super team, known as the Flight. Using a suit of armor that Hudson had designed for planetary exploration, he was given the code name Groundhog. thumb|left|200px|Groundhog On the Flight's first mission, to stop Egghead from launching a nuclear payload into New York City, many things went wrong: Smart Alec broke under the pressure, Wolverine could barely control himself and Saint Elmo had to sacrifice himself in order to save his friends. Sean left, disgruntled, telling Hudson, "If you want someone to wear that suit so badly, have the courage of your convictions -- and wear it yourself!" Charges were never laid against Benard for the killing of his fellow-policemen. He was last seen watching the unveiling of Alpha Flight.

sean boyle.name: Sean Boyle
sean boyle.origin: Sean Boyle wore a Spider-Man mask while mugging and so came to be nicknamed the "Spider-Mugger". After mugging Peter Parker, he discovered Spider-Man's Web-Shooters. Boyle deduced that his victim was Spider-Man. Boyle had surrendered the credit cards he stole to an employer and was killed when attempting to retrieve Parker's to learn the identity and home address of Spider-Man. His body was then dumped in an alley where Spider-Man discovered him and was accused by police officers of having killed him.

sean cassidy.name: Sean Cassidy
sean cassidy.origin: ===Early Years=== Sean Cassidy was born as the heir to the castle and estate of Cassidy Keep in Ireland, as well as a small fortune. He studied at Trinity College, Dublin, where he graduated with a Bachelor of Science. While hitchhiking one night, Sean drew the ire of a couple of policemen, who tried to arrest him without any charges. Seeing the situation from afar on her motorcycle, Maeve Rourke intervened to rescue the young Sean. After a long pursuit by three police cars, they managed to hit one of the tires and Maeve and Sean fell off a cliff. Sean, however, revealed himself to be a mutant and flew Maeve to safety. Over the years, both Sean and his cousin, Tom Cassidy, who was also a mutant, competed for Maeve's love, but Maeve eventually chose Sean. The young couple married on a spring afternoon in County Mayo. The band played Night in Soho and Stand by Your Man. They danced until dawn. Sean began working for Interpol, eventually rising to the rank of inspector. Sean was sent on a special mission, deep undercover. He became separated from Maeve for months with no way to contact her. When he left on the mission, Maeve was in her first month of pregnancy, although Sean didn't know it at the time. Their daughter, Theresa, was born during Sean's absence. Shortly after Theresa's birth, Maeve took the infant Theresa with her on a visit to her relatives in Armagh in Northern Ireland. While she was there, Maeve, an innocent bystander, was killed in a terrorist bombing along with a number of other people. Tom Cassidy got custody of the baby and raised her as his own, hiding the truth from Sean as well as Theresa for decades. On returning from his mission, Sean was informed that his wife was dead. At first, Cassidy attempted to escape his despair over this news by throwing himself into his work at Interpol. Eventually, however, the still melancholy Cassidy left Interpol to become a freelance operative and, as time went on, found himself engaged in some criminal activities. thumb|left|Under Factor Three's influence ===Factor Three=== The legal authorities never discovered that Cassidy was guilty of crimes, but the mutant known as the Changeling did, thanks to the technology of the subversive organization of superhumanly powerful mutants and their underlings known as Factor Three. The Changeling contacted Cassidy, who Factor Three's technology had also identified as a superhumanly powerful mutant and invited him to join the organization. Cassidy was appalled upon learning of Factor Three's goals and adamantly refused. However, the Changeling and his superior, the so-called Mutant Master, agreed that Cassidy's powers and knowledge of the workings of law enforcement agencies were too valuable for Factor Three to lose, and so they sent their agents to capture Cassidy. Factor Three placed a headband containing explosives around Cassidy's head. If Cassidy defied their orders, the headband could be detonated by remote control; it would also detonate if Cassidy attempted to remove the headband himself. Furthermore, Factor Three put Cassidy, who went by the code name of Banshee, under the supervision of one of their trusted human agents, the Ogre. Banshee thus felt forced to obey Factor Three's commands and accompanied by the Ogre, performed various criminal missions for the organization. While in New York City on a mission for Factor Three, Banshee clashed with the original X-Men, who captured both him and the Ogre. The X-Men's leader, Professor Charles Xavier, used a psionic "mental bolt" on Banshee's headband which prevented the detonation mechanism from functioning so that the Banshee could remove it. Once freed of the headband, Banshee told the X-Men all that he knew about Factor Three. Banshee discovered Factor Three's secret European headquarters, only to be recaptured. He participated in the X-Men's battle with the Mutant Master and it was his powers which exposed the Mutant Master as an extraterrestrial. ===X-Men=== thumb|right|Meeting Moira MacTaggert Banshee returned to an honest life and time passed without major incident for him, except for his brief captivity at the hands of the Sentinels, and by the second Secret Empire. Professor Xavier later invited Banshee to join the X-Men, when he was recruiting new members to battle the menace of Krakoa. After most of the original team left, Cassidy, along with fellow new recruits Colossus, Nightcrawler, Storm, Wolverine, and Thunderbird, stayed as members of the new X-Men. The second group of X-Men were mostly adults and required no tutoring from Professor X, but trained in the use of their powers, in the Danger Room. It was during this time that he met Prof. Xavier's silent partner, the Scottish geneticist Dr. Moira MacTaggert. Sean was among those captured by Steven Lang's Sentinels and taken aboard Lang's space station. After a trip to Cassidy Keep, they battled Juggernaut and Black Tom. thumb|left During a picnic, they briefly battled Weapon Alpha, who accidental

sean cassidy moira vii 1.name: Sean Cassidy (Moira-VII.1)
sean cassidy moira vii 1.species: Mutant bonded with the Spirit of Variance
sean cassidy moira vii 1.origin: ===Sins of Sinister=== ====Year 10==== While refuging at the Sanctum Sanctorum, Vox Ignis was attacted by the Legion of the Night. He managed to be use his Scream of Change on some of them, and converted Wagnerine, Wallcrawler and Auntie Fortune to his cause. The Legion of the Night became a group of Mother Righteous' followers and started stealing weapons and magical artifacts for her. When Mother Righteous's actions cause the death of Wallcrawler, Vox Ignis started doubting her methods. ====Year 100==== Vox Ignis spent years continuing to search for Nightkin that he could free and bring over to Mother Righteous' service, while the Sinisters destroyed virtually every opposition in the galaxy. Through the years he accompanied Mother Righteous as she visited various people, asking them what they would have done differently. After learning the troubles of the Nightkin from Wagnerine, he helped her convinced Mother Righteous to free the original Nightcrawler and Dr. Nemesis. When the rabid Nightcrawler attacked Mother Righteous for corrupting his idea of the spark, she killed him. When an angered Wagnerine attempted to kill Mother Righteous in revenge, she ordered Vox Ignis to kill her. He hesitated for a moment, prompting Mother Righteous to punish him and Wagnerine to flee, now knowing that Mother Righteous had stolen her infant daughter and made her a part of the reliquary. ====Year 1000==== Still in service to Mother Righteous, Vox Ignis was sent to find Galactus, who had become infested with Spirits of Vengeance. Hoping to ally with them, he found that the spirits still abhored the Spirit of Variance. He spent 56 years fleeing Galactus, and upon receiving word from Mother Righteous brought him to the World Farm where the Moira Engine was housed. To his shock, Mother Righteous had planned all this from the start, and had placed Galactus right in the path of the Juggernaut, who had been fired as a bullet into space nearly 1000 years before. Juggernaut killed Galactus, and together with the sacrifice of every Nightkin, Mother Righteous was finally free to enter the World Farm. Here, she revealed the truth of the Reliquary Perilous; that it was not a weapon intended to fix the universe, but instead a way for her to send her knowledge and memories of this timeline backwards to her past self when the timeline was ultimately reset due to the Moira clone's death. In addition, she separated the Spirit of Variance from Banshee, adding it to the reliquary. Before she could complete her schemes, Wagnerine arrived to kill her and free her daughter. Banshee betrayed her, and though he was too old and frail to even use his sonic scream, he distracted her long enough for Wagnerine to kill her. As Wagnerine left, Sean was shocked to see Moira appear. She suddenly shot him, and claimed the reliquary for herself.

sean collins.name: Sean Collins
sean collins.species: Presumably Mutant; Believed falsely to be Homo ultima
sean collins.origin: Sean Collins was the first child born on Avalon, the space station where Magneto assembled the mutants to ascend out of Earth. Born from the Acolytes Rusty Collins and Skids, Sean's genetic make-up readings were magnetically modified by Magneto in order to lure Hank McCoy and unite his fellow mutants, as a rift was forming in his community. The X-Factor analysis "revealed" that, at maturity, Sean would be able to alter his mutation at will, enabling him to choose himself his powers and therefore, he was part of an evolutionary jump as big from the mutants than was the jump of mutants from Humans, and could be the next step, Homo ultima, the ultimate being. While his parents were joyed by the news, McCoy expressed his doubts about what to think of it. Scanner learned the intel and soon reported it to the Acolytes "Annihilist faction" (in favor of taking Earth from the humans) and to their leader Fabian Cortez who feared that Homo ultima would turn against Homo superior and take Earth for themselves. In the same way, Milan informed Exodus who expressed same concerns. The two Acolytes factions sought the counsel of Magneto, who let them decide together what should be done, and they agreed on a truce, time to terminate the baby, with less opposition among their ranks. The Acolytes intercepted McCoy, Skids and Rusty while they were intending to exit the station with a space shuttle. Although Beast and the couple fought bravely, they were unable to prevent Amelia Voght from reluctantly asphyxiating the baby, immediately asking forgiveness for her actions and claiming "it was self-defense". Once Sean dead, the couple and Beast decided to leave forever the station, while the Acolytes granted gratitude to them, considering that their baby had been a warning for mutantkind and that they will unite to survive this threat. Days later, Colossus decided to leave at his turn, but not before consulting Magnus who admitted his actions, regrets and explained it. Peter left then, warning Magneto about the fact his lies might turn to be true one day.

sean dolan.name: Sean Dolan
sean dolan.origin: thumb|left|150px|Sean Dolan Sean Dolan was once the squire of the Black Knight. He somehow got ahold of the Ebony Blade and traveled around as a drifter until he decided to help repair the recently destroyed Slorenia. In Slorenia he was decided to draw the blade. As a result the souls of the deceased Slorenians were harvested into the blade turning him into the Bloodwraith. The Bloodwraith seemed unstoppable and could not be destroyed. The Avengers could not defeat him. The Scarlet Witch instead strengthened his bond to Slorenia, not only linking him to the people but to the borders as well, trapping him inside.

fields.notes: The Bloodwraith appears to be a separate entity that takes over Sean Dolan's body whenever he holds the unsheathed Ebony Blade. While the Bloodwraith is active on the Earthly plane, Dolan's soul exists within an ethereal realm of darkness within the blade and can sometimes exert an influence on the Bloodwraith's actions. Dolan is the only person who has been observed to be transformed in that way by the Ebony Blade. Although the Bloodwraith entity is clearly connected to the sword, its origin has yet to be revealed.

sean dunne.name: Sean Dunne
sean dunne.origin: Sean Dunne led a team of IRA terrorists who carried out an attack at Heathrow Airport in an unsuccessful attempt to kill Scotland Yard inspector John Bartlett, but which resulted in the deaths of innocent people. He managed to escape after the attack and hide in a safe house in London, which was revealed to Spider-Man by another terrorist whom he had knocked out and later interrogated in prison. In the hideout, together with other IRA terrorists, they attempted to organize a bomb attack on the British Parliament during a speech by Margaret Thatcher, an attack that was almost foiled by the intervention of Scotland Yard and MI-5, who stormed the terrorists' hideout, secretly aided by Spider-Man, who knocked out two terrorists, but Dunne and others managed to escape. Spider-Man later figured out what Dunn and the other terrorists were trying to do, namely to blow up the foundations of the British Parliament itself, so he sneaked into the London sewers beneath the British Parliament and stopped the attempt to detonate the dynamite by pulling the detonator wires, but Dunn threw a grenade so that the explosion would still trigger the dynamite. Spider-Man intercepted the grenade by trapping it to the wall with his web. Dunn tried to pull the grenade off the wall, but it exploded, causing him to lose an arm and an eye. Seriously injured, he was captured by the authorities.

sean garrison.name: Sean Garrison
sean garrison.origin: Throughout his youth Garrison used his pheromone powers to manipulate people into giving him anything he desired. He became involved with Gail Collins in this way, using his powers to manipulate her emotions so that she would fulfill his every desire. When Gail became pregnant his power over her vanished and she fled, never telling him about his unborn daughter. Many years later Garrison would be the host of a talk show and a renowned public figure in support of mutant rights, serving as counselor to many superhero figures. He gave the commencement address for a graduation at the University of Chicago. There were many protesters objecting to a mutant sympathizer being given a platform. He was approached by Emma Frost to serve as a therapist to Wither, a mutant student of the Xavier Institute with the ability to destroy any organic matter he touches. It is implied that Garrison used his abilities to manipulate conflict within the X-Men student body, such as using Wither's rivalry with Elixir to spark a feud between the students or pushing Blob to attack the Institute.

sean madigan.name: Sean Madigan
sean madigan.species: Human cyborg; reanimated skull and brain in a tank attached to a robot body.
sean madigan.origin: thumb|left|250px|Original appearance Sean was the son of George Tarleton, born after his mother Linda had an affair with him in college and who abandoned her when he learned she was pregnant. George would go on to join A.I.M. and become M.O.D.O.K. years later. When Sean grew up he joined A.I.M. himself and learned who his father was. Angry at having been abandoned by his father he began plotting from within A.I.M. and worked to undermine and destabilize them, to destroy what his father loved instead of him. To this end he retrieved a bomb that could destabilize DNA, claiming to some parts of A.I.M. that he would use it to stabilize his father and to others that he would use it to kill him. Once he had the device and his father he installed in his father's chair and was going to detonate the bomb in Times Square. The superhero Ms. Marvel (Carol Danvers) and her Lightning Storm team had become aware of his actions and background thanks to information provided by Monica Rappaccini. Ms. Marvel flew his father out of range when the device detonated and informed her that he knew what Sean was up to. Believing his father was dead, Sean carried on with his plan and broadcast to A.I.M across multiple worlds and encouraged them to splinter apart, but before he could finish his broadcast, he was shot in the head by Monica Rappaccini. His skull and brain were saved and preserved by A.I.M. agents from one of the many now fractured cells and reanimated, stored within a jar and attached to a robotic body.

sean madrox.name: Sean Madrox
sean madrox.species: Son of mutant duplicate; (seemingly dupe himself)
sean madrox.origin: ===Conception and Gestation=== After celebrating with copious libations, one night Jamie Madrox spent the night with both Siryn and M; at the same time in two different locations. Madrox unwittingly created a dupe (or two), which allowed him to sleep with both women. After reabsorbing the dupe(s), Madrox was left with a hazy understanding of what happened and two furious women. Not long after that night, Siryn discovered that she was pregnant. Although the conception was far from normal, Siryn's pregnancy went relatively smoothly with few problems. ===Birth and Absorption=== While in active labor, Siryn proposed and Madrox accepted. After a few hours labor, Siryn gave birth to a healthy baby boy and was able to share the experience with her friends and teammates from X-Factor. She decided to name the infant Sean, after her late father Sean Cassidy. This was also the first time she really admitted her father was dead; a trauma with which she was still dealing. thumb|200px|left|Madrox absorbing Sean However, just hours after his birth, Madrox held baby Sean and involuntarily absorbed him. Despite Madrox's efforts to stop and his mother's screams, Sean slowly disappeared into his father just like any other dupe. Siryn, filled with rage toward Jamie, broke his finger and told him to leave. thumb|250px|left|Madrox absorbing Sean Madrox later theorized that a dupe had actually slept with Siryn, not himself. Furthermore, the son of a duplicate is itself also a duplicate. As such, when Sean came into physical contact with Madrox Prime, he was absorbed just like any other dupe. Sean's short life had terrible and lasting effect on his parents, both of whom fell into deep depressions after his death.

Although the conception was far from normal, Siryn's pregnancy went relatively smoothly with few problems. ===Birth and Absorption=== While in active labor, Siryn proposed and Madrox accepted. After a few hours labor, Siryn gave birth to a healthy baby boy and was able to share the experience with her friends and teammates from X-Factor. She decided to name the infant Sean, after her late father Sean Cassidy. This was also the first time she really admitted her father was dead; a trauma with which she was still dealing. thumb|200px|left|Madrox absorbing Sean However, just hours after his birth, Madrox held baby Sean and involuntarily absorbed him. Despite Madrox's efforts to stop and his mother's screams, Sean slowly disappeared into his father just like any other dupe. Siryn, filled with rage toward Jamie, broke his finger and told him to leave. thumb|250px|left|Madrox absorbing Sean Madrox later theorized that a dupe had actually slept with Siryn, not himself. Furthermore, the son of a duplicate is itself also a duplicate. As such, when Sean came into physical contact with Madrox Prime, he was absorbed just like any other dupe. Sean's short life had terrible and lasting effect on his parents, both of whom fell into deep depressions after his death.
powers: Sean potentially had the ability of Kinetic Duplication like Madrox and his dupes, but he never demonstrated this power.
fields.trivia: Sean Madrox was named after his maternal grandfather, Sean Cassidy. Once Madrox was asked if it hurts to absorb his dupes and he answered that it hurt one time, seemingly a reference to Sean.
fields.species: Son of mutant duplicate; (seemingly dupe himself)

sean watanabe.name: Sean Watanabe
sean watanabe.origin: Sean Watanabe was trained in the martial arts by his father Yuji. In competition Sean always seemed to know his opponent's next move. He joined the military and became a member of the Navy SEAL's. He was given the nickname of Brass for taking on the tough jobs. After he ended his military service, Sean met a woman named Theresa, whom he planned to marry. However, they were near Avengers Mansion, which was attacked by the Mandarin during the 'Acts of Vengeance' conspiracy. Theresa fled into the street during the confusion and was struck by a car. Angry, Sean vowed he would go after all responsible. He started by attacking the Mandarin's operations in Chinatown. Deathwatch sent his men looking for all allies of Dan Ketch and the Ghost Rider. Sean's father Yuji was one of those attacked. Sean's sister was abducted and Jack D'Auria was wounded. Sean tracked the kidnappers to Cypress Hills Cemetery, where he encountered Wolverine and Ghost Rider (Dan Ketch). The three joined forces to save Sean's sister and Jack. ===After M-Day=== Sean was depowered during M-Day, but still was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative after the Civil War, due to his fighting skills and military background.

seaweed man.name: Seaweed Man
seaweed man.origin: ===Guardian of the Cave=== As part of his ongoing quest to recover Neptune's enchanted trident, Sub-Mariner was tasked with venturing into Cave of Shadows. However, before he could claim the legendary weapon, he first had to overcome a formidable guardian—the monstrous Seaweed Man. Namor quickly realised that he was outmatched in sheer strength and endurance, as the creature’s tangled, sinewy form made it nearly impervious to direct attacks. Instead of engaging it in prolonged combat, the Sub-Mariner relied on his superior speed and tactical prowess. He swam in rapid circles around the Seaweed Man, creating a powerful vortex that ensnared and immobilised the creature just long enough for him to slip into the cave. There, Namor recovered the next crucial clue in his quest before making his escape, leaving the Seaweed Man trapped in the swirling waters behind him. ===Dire Wraiths=== Sometime later the monstrous Seaweed Man lay dormant in the ocean depths, until a sinister faction of Dire Wraith sorceresses uncovered its resting place. As part of their broader scheme to conquer Earth, the Wraiths sought to claim Atlantis as a strategic stronghold. To accomplish this, they planned to harness the Seaweed Man’s immense latent power. Using an enchanted Black Pearl, they amplified their own dark magic and began a ritual to awaken the ancient sleeper. However, their plans did not go unnoticed. Both Rom, the Spaceknight, and Namor, the Sub-Mariner, arrived separately but swiftly recognised the greater threat at hand. Though the two warriors initially clashed, they quickly realised they shared a common enemy. Before they could intervene, several of the Dire Wraiths, realising they could not win through conventional means, sacrificed themselves, transferring their dark energies into the Pearl. The ritual’s final surge of power succeeded in fully awakening the Seaweed Man, but with an unintended consequence—the infusion of corrupt magic had transformed it into a rampaging force of destruction. Now more powerful than ever, the Seaweed Man ignored both Namor and Rom, setting its sights directly on Atlantis. As the massive creature advanced, the city's defenses proved woefully ineffective against its enchanted, ever-shifting form. Realising that brute force alone would not stop the monster, Namor recalled his earlier victory over it. He convinced Rom to aid him in recreating an even larger vortex, hoping to subdue it once more. However, the Seaweed Man, now bolstered by dark magic, proved far more resistant than before. Seeing no other option, Rom unleashed a sustained barrage of energy blasts from his Neutralizer, targeting the creature’s magical core. As the blasts drained its supernatural essence, the vortex at last took full effect, tearing the creature apart. The once-monstrous Seaweed Man was reduced to nothing more than harmless strands of seaweed, adrift in the ocean currents. Or so it seemed… but, as some whispered, the darkness that had infused it might still linger, waiting for another opportunity to rise again.

sebastian.name: Sebastian
sebastian.origin: Sebastian is a college student from Chicago who became a member of a gang of Mutants known as the Ghosts of Cyclops, who justified their violent attacks claiming to follow the legacy of the deceased Cyclops. Cyclops' time-displaced younger counterpart started tracking the Ghosts of Cyclops, and discovered a pattern to their attacks, so he was able to be present during their following appearance. The Ghost appeared and started scaring people, and the young Cyclops confronted them until the police arrived and they fled. After the confrontation the young Cyclops was able to track him down to Algar University. When he entered the facility, two of the members of the Ghost recognized him and alerted their boss. They put on their masks, confronted him in the library and began to beat him ending with the police arresting the young Cyclops and Thirst leader of the cyclops ghosts. While in custody, the rest of the Cyclops Phantasms came to Thirst's rescue, swiftly subduing the officers at the facility. However, when they tried to escape, they found themselves surrounded by dozens of S.W.A.T. When they decided to fight their way through the cops, the X-Men arrived and fought them. Both mutant teams ended up surrounded by officers, and Thirst tried to convince his teammates to keep fighting. When a cop ordered to open fire at the Ghost of Cyclops, the young Cyclops projected an energy blast in the space between them to get their attention, and gave a speech that convinced the officers to act non-lethally. Her current status is unknown.

sebastian derik.name: Sebastian Derik
sebastian derik.species: Sebastian Derik was a test subject revived through the T.A.H.I.T.I. project, but was driven crazy by the GH.325 serum and became obsessed with a series of carvings.
sebastian derik.origin: Sebastian Derik was an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. Derik was at some point killed in the line of duty, but was chosen to be one of the test subject for the T.A.H.I.T.I. project. Derik was revived as part of the project, but exposure to the GH.325 serum drove the test subjects insane and they became obsessed with a series of mysterious glyphs. Agent Phil Coulson, as the head of the T.A.H.I.T.I. project, came up with the idea of "erasing" them, implanting the test subjects with false memories and giving them a new identity. Derik was among the last subjects to start showing symptoms, but Coulson had him erased when he discovered Derik was carving the glyphs into his own body. Years later, Derik had covered his body in tattoos of the glyphs. He had realized he could bring back his memories of the T.A.H.I.T.I. project by experiencing pain, and started hunting down the remaining test subjects. After killing Janice Robbins, the former Agent Rebecca Stevens, the now-Director Phil Coulson took notice of Derik's activities. However, Coulson and S.H.I.E.L.D. did not know which former T.A.H.I.T.I. test subject was doing the killings, and Coulson subjected himself to a memory machine to bring back his memories of the project. Meanwhile, Derik tracked down the only other remaining test subject, Hank Thompson, but he could not help Derik understand the carvings any further. Once Coulson had arrived at Thompson's residence and demanded at gunpoint he reveal anything he knew about the carvings, Derik was able to sneak up behind him and knock him out. Derik then tied up Coulson, Thompson, and Thompson's family in Thompson's barn where Thompson and his son had assembled a model train set. Derik started retelling his story to Coulson, but Thompson managed to cut his way out of his binds. Derik noticed he was escaping and threw his knife at him, but Thompson managed to catch it in mid-air and throw it back at him. Derik managed to dodge the knife but it cut through Coulson's bonds as well, freeing him. Derik and Coulson started fighting while Coulson tried to get Derik to realize something he had discovered about the carvings. Coulson eventually has Derik over a railing that looks down on Thompson's train set, but S.H.I.E.L.D. agents arrive on he scene to apprehend both Derik and Coulson. Fearing their director might be lost to the GH.235 serum, they pull their guns on the two of them and are prepared to shoot. Just as they are about to shoot, Derik opened his eyes and saw what Coulson was trying to show him. The carvings are meant to be viewed in three dimensions, revealing them as a blueprint for a city. With Derik subdued, he is turned over to the authorities for his crimes.

sebastian druid.species: Human/monster hybrid son of Doctor Druid
sebastian druid.origin: ===Early life=== Before the Skrulls' Secret Invasion started, Nick Fury tasked Daisy Johnson with recruiting select individuals that he had files on for what would become his secret strike force team. Sebastian Druid was approached by Daisy, after he sought out Doctor Strange to help him learn about his powers. While he was the son of Doctor Druid, he also had monster DNA, making his powers seemingly chemical in nature. left|thumb|150px|The Druid ===Secret Invasion=== As a member of the "Secret Warriors" he was given the code name Druid and was trained alongside Stonewall, Phobos, Yo-Yo Rodriguez, and Hellfire. One of their first missions was to take out the Dard'van, the religious sect of Skrulls leading the invasion. After the battle, Druid and the team struggled to deal with the fallout of the invasion. ===Hydra=== The Secret Warriors were observing activity at an old S.H.I.E.L.D. base in Texas when they discovered Hydra operatives attempting to steal something. In defiance of their orders to observe only, Slingshot, Druid, and Stonewall engaged the terrorists. During a meal with the team, Phobos told them he could see the future and prophesies about each member, he told he Druid that he would become a great hero. Following Slingshot's severe injuries at the hands of the Gorgon, Daisy and Druid traveled to Australia to recruit Eden Fesi as a replacement. After too many failures with the team, Druid was given a note saying that he was a liability and to go home. ===Return=== It was a ruse, however, and when Sebastian arrived home, he found John Garrett waiting for him. He spent two months getting Druid into shape, then took him on training missions to help Fury, such as destroying the remains of two crashed Helicarriers before the Chinese could examine the technology and creating a magic bullet that can shoot through walls so that Garrett could assassinate Leviathan agent Magadan and pin it on Hydra. When Fury's assault on the Hydra base Gehenna went sideways, Sebastian was in the plane that picked the team up. With Hydra jets in pursuit, Sebastian overrode Fury's plan and used his powers to destroy all the following jets by himself, which impressed Fury. Once back at Fury's base Excalibur, Garrett told Sebastian how proud he was of him, but after the last mission left Hellfire and Phobos dead, Eden Fesi in a coma, and Daisy heartbroken, the Caterpillar team was disbanded.

sebastian edwards.origin: Sebastian Edwards was a member of the Esper Division of F.I.6 when they were sent in to deal with an unknown villian. The backlash from their telepathic probe killed all three Esper Division members present.

sebastian fenhoff.name: Sebastian Fenhoff
sebastian fenhoff.origin: Dr. Sebastian Fenhoff was a Hydra operative inserted in the past by the sentient Cosmic Cube Kobik when she rewrote Captain America's life so that in the present he would be a Hydra agent himself. Fenhoff indoctrinated children at the Keep. When Elisa Sinclair brought in a sickly boy named Steve Rogers to Fenhoff, he immediately disapproved but relented once Sinclair used her mystical powers against him. However, Rogers proved to be an incredibly difficult child and resisted all of Fenhoff's methods of reeducation, causing Fenhoff to suggest euthanizing him. After the Kraken finally turned Rogers to Hydra's side, Rogers became Fenhoff's greatest academic student. After meeting with other Hydra leaders, Fenhoff and the Kraken sent Rogers on his mission to infiltrate the United States of America on the path into becoming Captain Amierca while secretly working for Hydra.

sebastian patane.name: Sebastian Patane
sebastian patane.origin: Sebastian Patane was the second Cat-Man, following the apparent death of the first alongside the rest of the original Ani-Men. Patane and his cohorts in the newly reformed Unholy Three, Bird-Man and Ape-Man, were hired by the Death Stalker to assist him, but both Cat-Man and Ape-Man were later killed by Death Stalker.

sebastian ruud.name: Sebastian Ruud
sebastian ruud.origin: Wulff began his adolescent life allied with a group of miscreants named the Wild Boys who went about causing trouble and harm to others. During the course of his tenure with them, the Wild Boys came to Halo City. Wulff had a change of heart towards the ideals of the group and left them, which they saw as a "betrayal". While dodging his former friends, Wulff was rescued by Morphine Somers and brought to the Xavier's Home for Indigent Children, where he joined X-Nation. It was some time later that Avian decided to mount a mission to recapture Willow in a bid to be the first to find the messiah for himself. He attacks the children and succeeds in capturing Willow again. Wanting to rescue their friend, X-Nation decide to infiltrate the Million Palms facility and save her. However, their fledgling efforts ended in their capture. They undergo brutal torture. They were able to escape, but upon their return home they found that Xavier's was devastated. Their home, an orphanage, had been blown up by the Atlantean army and their city was being flooded. The staff who had raised them, the Sisterhood of the Howling Commandos, had been murdered. The crew spends days on the street, tired, hungry and homeless. To add insult to injury, Exodus had awoken from another century-long slumber and tried to make X-Nation his Acolytes. They refused and were subsequently beaten alongside the Wild Boys, who had sought out Wulff for revenge. After they were revived, Exodus continued to try and sway their opinion to his side, but some implicitly didn't trust Exodus. The rest of the group joins in that opinion when Exodus refuses to save the human population of Halo City. They reject his leadership. After Clarion sacrificed himself in the battle with Exodus, the rest of the kids were teleported away by Mademoiselle Strange to face their uncertain futures. They traveled to the Savage Land, the last habitable place on Earth, and began to form a society there. While they were building the settlement, a person who was infected with the techno-organic virus washes up on shore and warns Spider-Man about the "city in the mists". Spider-Man set out on a boat to investigate with Wulff and Uproar stowed away secretly. Their boat was blown up by the Wild Boys, who had started a floating boat colony off the coast. Wulff and Uproar were fished out of the water by them and, when they discovered that they had captured the "traitor" to their group, began to devise wicked plans for them. They put Wulff through a procedure called "the gauntlet" which mutated him further into a more lupine form. Then they forced Wulff to fight Uproar in a gladiator arena to the death. Fortunately, Uproar is able to revert his friend to a more sensible mindframe though he is distressed by his more animalistic form. The pair is saved by a mysterious woman named Fiona. She leads them to the man in charge, the Vulture. Wulff tries to gain revenge but the Wild Boys intervene and Wulff is badly injured in the fray. The pair escapes but becomes stuck at sea. While there, Wulff begins to explore his new heightened form and realizes that he wants to more fully discover himself. He dives off of the boat, seemingly leaving Uproar to himself. Wulff tells his friend he hears of a boat nearby that should rescue him.

sebastian scrogg.name: Sebastian Scrogg
sebastian scrogg.origin: Sebastian Scrogg has been trying to create a potion of immortality for years. He shelters a fugitive, Arthur, because he will have to put up with whatever he makes him do, and however he treats him. Arthur assist Sebastian however he can. Eventually, Sebastian realizes that Redwood trees are practically immortal, and using sap from said tree, he finally succeeds. Before he can drink the potion, Arthur kills him, and drinks it himself. He becomes immortal by growing roots and effectively becoming a tree.

sebastian shaw.name: Sebastian Shaw
sebastian shaw.origin: ===Early Life=== Sebastian Shaw was descended from the once-prominent Shaw family of England, whose members had longstanding connections to the Hellfire Club. As part of Project: Cronus, Sinister genetically modified children including a young Sebastian without his father's consent. Suspecting Sinister intended eventually to claim his son's body, Jacob Shaw stole his research and constructed a device capable of protecting Sebastian from Project Cronus' activation signal. He made Sebastian promise to keep the machine nearby. Jacob subsequently moved his family to the United States and settled in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, where he worked as a miner. Sebastian grew up in poverty and worked in a steel mill while completing high school. Sebastian eventually received a full scholarship to study engineering at the Stevens Institute of Technology. Jacob died shortly afterwards, leaving Sebastian on his own. Around this period, Shaw first became aware of his unusual physical abilities. After a group of wealthy students attacked him over his working-class background and admission to college, their blows strengthened him instead of incapacitating him. Empowered by the kinetic energy he absorbed, Shaw easily defeated them. Shaw excelled academically and became a successful engineer and business consultant before establishing Shaw Industries, accumulating his first million by the age of thirty and his first billion by forty. ===Meeting Tessa=== During his early career, Shaw became acquainted with Charles Xavier and travelled to Afghanistan, where both men encountered the young mutant who would later become known as Tessa. Tessa's exceptional analytical abilities allowed her to assess rapidly changing situations with extraordinary precision, and she saved Shaw's life during the conflict. Shaw subsequently brought her into his organisation as one of his closest assistants. Unknown to Shaw, Xavier had recognised that Sebastian's growing pursuit of wealth and influence might make him dangerous and recruited Tessa to remain close to him as a covert observer. Thus, from the beginning of her service to Shaw, one of his most trusted confidantes was secretly reporting his activities to Xavier. ===Hellfire Club=== left|thumb|Sebastian Shaw and Lourdes Chantel During his rise in business, Shaw became romantically involved with mutant teleporter Lourdes Chantel. Shaw's success and family background eventually attracted the attention of the Hellfire Club. Within the Club he became close to its White King, Edward "Ned" Buckman, and rose to the position of Black Bishop. Shaw surrounded himself with individuals he considered useful and trustworthy. Among them were Harry Leland, Emma Frost, Donald Pierce, and Tessa. Shaw and Leland encountered Emma while she was working as a dancer at the Club and helped her establish the business connections that contributed to her own rise in wealth and influence. Pierce became indebted to Shaw after Shaw developed cybernetic replacements for injuries Pierce had suffered. Shaw also raised Shinobi Shaw as his son. Shinobi's mother had been involved with both Shaw and Harry Leland, although Shaw claimed and raised the child as his own. Their relationship became severely dysfunctional, with Sebastian frequently belittling Shinobi for failing to meet his expectations. ===Project: Armageddon=== Shaw entered into a partnership with Buckman known as Project: Armageddon. Shaw believed control of the mutant genome could become an extraordinary source of commercial and political power. His goal was to capture and study mutants, particularly the X-Men, and eventually monopolise practical applications of the X-Gene. Lourdes grew increasingly uncomfortable with Shaw's ambitions and Buckman's influence over him. Shaw ignored her warnings and proposed marriage, but their relationship deteriorated as Shaw became increasingly controlling and abusive. Buckman's true intentions ultimately proved different from Shaw's. He rebuilt Sentinel technology and programmed the machines to eradicate carriers of the X-Gene, including the mutant members of the Hellfire Club. When Emma uncovered Buckman's plan, Sentinels attacked her and Leland. Shaw brought himself and Tessa to their aid with Lourdes' teleportation. During the battle, Shaw was made to believe Lourdes had been killed while protecting him. Blaming himself for her apparent death, Shaw joined Emma, Leland, and Tessa in overthrowing Buckman's regime. Emma telepathically forced Buckman to turn on his own allies before Shaw personally killed him. Shaw then seized control of the Club as its new Black King. Unknown to Shaw, Lourdes had survived. Emma had created the illusion of her death so that Lourdes could escape Sebastian. Afterward, Emma sent Lourdes to Wilson Fisk, who helped establish a new identity for her, leaving Shaw unaware of her true fate for decades. ===The New Inner Circle=== Shaw reorganised the Hellfire Club around a mutant-dominated Inner Circle. Harry Lel

fields.history: ===Early Life=== Sebastian Shaw was descended from the once-prominent Shaw family of England, whose members had longstanding connections to the Hellfire Club. As part of Project: Cronus, Sinister genetically modified children including a young Sebastian without his father's consent. Suspecting Sinister intended eventually to claim his son's body, Jacob Shaw stole his research and constructed a device capable of protecting Sebastian from Project Cronus' activation signal. He made Sebastian promise to keep the machine nearby. Jacob subsequently moved his family to the United States and settled in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, where he worked as a miner. Sebastian grew up in poverty and worked in a steel mill while completing high school. Sebastian eventually received a full scholarship to study engineering at the Stevens Institute of Technology. Jacob died shortly afterwards, leaving Sebastian on his own. Around this period, Shaw first became aware of his unusual physical abilities. After a group of wealthy students attacked him over his working-class background and admission to college, their blows strengthened him instead of incapacitating him. Empowered by the kinetic energy he absorbed, Shaw easily defeated them. Shaw excelled academically and became a successful engineer and business consultant before establishing Shaw Industries, accumulating his first million by the age of thirty and his first billion by forty. ===Meeting Tessa=== During his early career, Shaw became acquainted with Charles Xavier and travelled to Afghanistan, where both men encountered the young mutant who would later become known as Tessa. Tessa's exceptional analytical abilities allowed her to assess rapidly changing situations with extraordinary precision, and she saved Shaw's life during the conflict. Shaw subsequently brought her into his organisation as one of his closest assistants. Unknown to Shaw, Xavier had recognised that Sebastian's growing pursuit of wealth and influence might make him dangerous and recruited Tessa to remain close to him as a covert observer. Thus, from the beginning of her service to Shaw, one of his most trusted confidantes was secretly reporting his activities to Xavier. ===Hellfire Club=== left|thumb|Sebastian Shaw and Lourdes Chantel During his rise in business, Shaw became romantically involved with mutant teleporter Lourdes Chantel. Shaw's success and family background eventually attracted the attention of the Hellfire Club. Within the Club he became close to its White King, Edward "Ned" Buckman, and rose to the position of Black Bishop. Shaw surrounded himself with individuals he considered useful and trustworthy. Among them were Harry Leland, Emma Frost, Donald Pierce, and Tessa. Shaw and Leland encountered Emma while she was working as a dancer at the Club and helped her establish the business connections that contributed to her own rise in wealth and influence. Pierce became indebted to Shaw after Shaw developed cybernetic replacements for injuries Pierce had suffered. Shaw also raised Shinobi Shaw as his son. Shinobi's mother had been involved with both Shaw and Harry Leland, although Shaw claimed and raised the child as his own. Their relationship became severely dysfunctional, with Sebastian frequently belittling Shinobi for failing to meet his expectations. ===Project: Armageddon=== Shaw entered into a partnership with Buckman known as Project: Armageddon. Shaw believed control of the mutant genome could become an extraordinary source of commercial and political power. His goal was to capture and study mutants, particularly the X-Men, and eventually monopolise practical applications of the X-Gene. Lourdes grew increasingly uncomfortable with Shaw's ambitions and Buckman's influence over him. Shaw ignored her warnings and proposed marriage, but their relationship deteriorated as Shaw became increasingly controlling and abusive. Buckman's true intentions ultimately proved different from Shaw's. He rebuilt Sentinel technology and programmed the machines to eradicate carriers of the X-Gene, including the mutant members of the Hellfire Club. When Emma uncovered Buckman's plan, Sentinels attacked her and Leland. Shaw brought himself and Tessa to their aid with Lourdes' teleportation. During the battle, Shaw was made to believe Lourdes had been killed while protecting him. Blaming himself for her apparent death, Shaw joined Emma, Leland, and Tessa in overthrowing Buckman's regime. Emma telepathically forced Buckman to turn on his own allies before Shaw personally killed him. Shaw then seized control of the Club as its new Black King. Unknown to Shaw, Lourdes had survived. Emma had created the illusion of her death so that Lourdes could escape Sebastian. Afterward, Emma sent Lourdes to Wilson Fisk, who helped establish a new identity for her, leaving Shaw unaware of her true fate for decades. ===The New Inner Circle=== Shaw reorganised the Hellfire Club around a mutant-dominated Inner Circle. fields.personality: Sebastian Shaw is as ambitious as he is ruthless. Since youth, Shaw has striven to prove his superiority to those around him and delights in wielding power. He is both vengeful and spiteful, sensitive to slights and prone to holding grudges. Despite his hatred for his father, he takes great pride in the Shaw family name, and strives to uphold its legacy. While he has embraced mutantkind at times, he has done so only with a view to how he himself might profit. He views his mutation as simply one tool among many, not a significant marker of identity. While his fellow mutant power-brokers such as Magneto or Professor X concern themselves with the fate of mutantkind first and foremost, Shaw's ambitions have always been to dominate the entire world, no matter the cost to others. When he wishes to be, Shaw is a charmer and a skilled negotiator, diplomat and businessman. However, this veneer hides his true ruthless nature. He is a habitual abuser, particularly of the women around him. While he holds himself in high opinion, he has no illusions about who he is and what he does. He knows that a reckoning will come - in the next life, if not this one - and he is prepared to meet it with a smile on his face.
fields.additional_attributes: Paralyzed (formerly): After having ingested a poisoned drink, Shaw could no longer walk and was confined to a wheelchair.
equipment: Shaw has the resources of both his own corporation and the Hellfire Club at his disposal. He once used an Image Inducer.
weapons: Hellfire Armor
fields.notes: No criminal record; the general public is unaware of Shaw's criminal activities. What's more, his being a mutant was documented by the O*N*E. However, due to his social and financial standing, he was above the jurisdiction of the O*N*E. According to Emma Frost, Shaw is "...a sexually obsessed little cretin". She also stated that Shaw designed the New York Branch Hellfire Club building "...with all of his personal kinks and perversions in mind..." (with having been shown).
fields.trivia: Shaw's creators, John Byrne and Chris Claremont, based Sebastian Shaw's appearance and last name on the British-born actor .

sebastian shaw moira vii 1.name: Sebastian Shaw (Moira-VII.1)
sebastian shaw moira vii 1.origin: Sebastian Shaw was one of many mutants corrupted by Mister Sinister, and turned into a modified Sinister-clone. As a member of the Quiet Council of Sinisters, Shaw was instrumental in the Sinisters' conquest of Earth. Shaw became a Hell Lord in order to grant the Sinisters a seat on the Infernal Parliament, with the Waiting Room converted into a Hell. His connections allowed the Sinisters to borrow the Twilight Sword and destroy the Bifrost. Nearly 900 years later, mutants were the undisputed rulers of the galaxy. With their enemies long since destroyed, they instead turned on each other, leading to the creation of at least a million Sinister-derived gene polities. Shaw, along with his clones, constituted a ruling majority in the Screaming Council of Hell. Over the years, he cast enchantments upon Emma Frost's diamond form, seemingly culminating in turning her into a living Crimson Gem of Cyttorak. Shaw was presumably killed when Sinister, finally having regained access to his lab, used a kill-switch to kill every mutant in the galaxy.

sebastian szardos.name: Sebastian Szardos
sebastian szardos.origin: Sebastian Szardos was a descendant of witches originating from Wundagore Mountain. When he and his unit were sent to fight against the Thule Society in the Himalayas, everyone in the unit but him were killed by ghosts. Szardos ended up killing the ghosts, before waking up and coming face to face with the Ancient One. The Ancient One started training him in the mystic arts, giving him the Eye of Agamotto. During World War II, he became the leader of the Secret Invaders. In 1943, he went on a mission in the Irish Seas, where he found and destroyed U-666, a Nazi U-Boat being possessed by a spirit. He then woke up on a nearby island, where he met other soldiers who had their vessels sunk by U-666. However, the spirit, who survived, started possessing the soldiers, demanding Szardos give him the Eye of Agamotto. Szardos ended up killing all the survivors. He then consulted the Ancient One in astral form, who told him the way to exorcise the spirit. He was then attacked by the Nazis. With the help of the time-traveling Avengers, who secretly aided Szardos by fighting off the Nazis and leaving him a fighter jet, he was able to exorcise the spirit, who he learned was Mephisto, from one of the fighter pilots. He was then relocated by the Secret Invaders.

sebastian warn.name: Sebastian Warn
sebastian warn.first_appearance: Marvel's Wastelanders: Old Man Star-Lord Season 1 4
sebastian warn.origin: Sebastian Warn was a friend of Red Crotter and a secret member of a revolutionary movement called the Second Dawn. He was found out by the government, who arrested him and forced him to compete to the death against Kraven the Hunter in a reality show called "Deer on a Spear." Despite putting up a good fight, coupled with an unsuccessful rescue attempt by Star-Lord, Kraven eventually overcame and killed Sebastian. In his final moments, during the live broadcast, he called for others to rise up against Doom.

sebastion gilberti.name: Sebastion Gilberti
sebastion gilberti.species: Bastion was created when Nimrod and Master Mold were merged by the Siege Perilous; Sentinel Android
sebastion gilberti.origin: ===Origin=== Bastion was "born" when the giant robotic Sentinel Master Mold, having absorbed the advanced Sentinel prototype Nimrod into its systems, fought the X-Men who saw no other way to stop the virtually indestructible amalgam except to force it through the Siege Perilous, a pan-dimensional portal which subjects those who pass through to the judgment of the universe's higher powers. Re-emerging from the portal as an amnesiac Human/Sentinel hybrid with a seemingly immortal essence, he was taken in by a woman named Rose Gilberti. Living with Rose, she adopted him as a surrogate son and gave him the name Sebastion Gilberti. He began to hear about America's mutant problem. At some point, Bastion fell in with anti-mutant groups, like Graydon Creed's Friends of Humanity. ===Operation: Zero Tolerance=== Bastion's prime directives were soon reawakened, and he began assembling the international anti-mutant strike force Operation: Zero Tolerance (OZT). They attempted to reconfigure the Sentinel force assembled by Project: Wideawake, but Bastion deemed most of them outdated. Instead, he had a number of humans secretly outfitted with nano-technology to be Prime Sentinels. After Professor X voluntarily turned himself in after the events of Onslaught, Bastion confined him in an OZT facility along with the artificially-created mutant Mannites. Bastion also killed a Daily Bugle reporter who was going to report on Graydon Creed's history. He then captured Jubilee. Soon after, Bastion put OZT into full effect, utilizing the Prime Sentinels and quickly capturing several X-Men members. Bastion took control of the Xavier Institute and accessed Xavier's files in search of the Xavier Protocols, despite opposition from Cable and Caliban of X-Force. The captured X-Men and Jubilee ultimately managed to escape. OZT was shut down by the U.S. government after Henry Peter Gyrich and Senator Robert Kelly asked the President of the United States to intervene. Bastion was remanded into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, but he escaped and returned to the former OZT facility. There, he absorbed the energy from the Master Mold unit with which he had created the Prime Sentinels and sought to transform Machine Man into the Sentinel Supreme. He was opposed by Cable, and seemingly destroyed. Bastion survived and was recaptured by S.H.I.E.L.D. Death was sent to kill the Mannites, but also attacked Bastion, leaving only his head intact. Bastion's head was recovered by the robotic Gatekeeper servants of the techno-organic being Mainspring. Bastion co-opted one of the Gatekeeper's bodies, and used it to attack the techno-organic hero Warlock and his allies, being eventually defeated. Bastion's head was later recovered by Mainspring, who stripped away the layers of his programming to reveal the original Master Mold's source code and, using the alien transmode virus he was infected with, rewrote Bastion's programming, transforming him into Template. The virus soon took complete control of Template and forced him to construct a Babel Spire on Earth to signal the alien Technarchy. To oppose them, Mainspring destroyed himself along with Template, while Warlock managed to destroy the Babel Spire. Bastion's head was later retrieved by U.S. government agents in order to access the information he had stolen from Xavier's files. The information was retrieved by Shadowcat, Wolverine, and Gambit, but not before Bastion attempted to sow mistrust among them by confronting them with misleading holographic scenarios. Although they got the files, the X-Men were showing signs of doubt within themselves and their team. ===X-Force=== After the events of the Messiah Complex, the Purifiers infiltrated a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility with the help of double agents and stole Bastion's head, reattaching it to a Nimrod's body. Once online, he alerted the Purifiers to the presence of the mutant team X-Force in their church. After their escape, Bastion realized there was no terrestrial force that could destroy the X-Men and finally eliminate the remaining mutant population, so he created one by capturing some of the prominent enemies of the X-Men and resurrecting others that had been dead. He took control of them by implanting them with the techno-organic virus of Magus. After that, he faced a coup d'état from Matthew Risman and his Choir, while also contending with the X-Force team which had followed Archangel, who sensed his stolen wings within the Choir. Bastion fought Wolverine, but calculated that the risk was too high to fight him directly and escaped with the resurrected X-Men enemies. ===Second Coming=== thumb|right As part of Bastion and the Human Council's plan to kill the Messiah Child and destroy mutantkind, when Cable and Hope returned to the present, Bastion ordered William Stryker's Purifiers, the Leper Queen's Sapien League, and Cameron Hodge's Right Smiley Faces to kill them. To cripple the X-Men he ordered his underlings to target their teleporters and destroy all transport

Bastion co-opted one of the Gatekeeper's bodies, and used it to attack the techno-organic hero Warlock and his allies, being eventually defeated. Bastion's head was later recovered by Mainspring, who stripped away the layers of his programming to reveal the original Master Mold's source code and, using the alien transmode virus he was infected with, rewrote Bastion's programming, transforming him into Template. The virus soon took complete control of Template and forced him to construct a Babel Spire on Earth to signal the alien Technarchy. To oppose them, Mainspring destroyed himself along with Template, while Warlock managed to destroy the Babel Spire. Bastion's head was later retrieved by U.S. government agents in order to access the information he had stolen from Xavier's files. The information was retrieved by Shadowcat, Wolverine, and Gambit, but not before Bastion attempted to sow mistrust among them by confronting them with misleading holographic scenarios. Although they got the files, the X-Men were showing signs of doubt within themselves and their team. ===X-Force=== After the events of the Messiah Complex, the Purifiers infiltrated a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility with the help of double agents and stole Bastion's head, reattaching it to a Nimrod's body. Once online, he alerted the Purifiers to the presence of the mutant team X-Force in their church. After their escape, Bastion realized there was no terrestrial force that could destroy the X-Men and finally eliminate the remaining mutant population, so he created one by capturing some of the prominent enemies of the X-Men and resurrecting others that had been dead. He took control of them by implanting them with the techno-organic virus of Magus. After that, he faced a coup d'état from Matthew Risman and his Choir, while also contending with the X-Force team which had followed Archangel, who sensed his stolen wings within the Choir. Bastion fought Wolverine, but calculated that the risk was too high to fight him directly and escaped with the resurrected X-Men enemies. ===Second Coming=== thumb|right As part of Bastion and the Human Council's plan to kill the Messiah Child and destroy mutantkind, when Cable and Hope returned to the present, Bastion ordered William Stryker's Purifiers, the Leper Queen's Sapien League, and Cameron Hodge's Right Smiley Faces to kill them. To cripple the X-Men he ordered his underlings to target their teleporters and destroy all transport

sebastian diaz.name: Sebastián Diaz
sebastian diaz.origin: In 2005, Sebastián Diaz kicked his own son, Marcos out on the streets just for simply refusing to hide his mutant powers. In 2012, Sebastián had been diagnosed with cancer and he had ended up in a Catholic church on the outskirts of Bogotá in Colombia. Marcos had visited him and had offered to take him to a better hospital in an attempt to reconcile, but Sebastian had refused and had insulted Marcos for using his powers to be part of the Mexican cartel. Sebastian had said that he was going to Heaven, but Marcos rebuked him, expressing that his father was no better for abandoning his own son and for driving his wife to an early grave, and coldly told Sebastian that when he dies, he would not be going to Heaven, but to Hell. But unfortunately for Sebastian, he could not counter any of Marcos' remarks, because he knew that they were true, as was going to Hell and will pay for all of the sins that he had committed, regarding Sebastian's mistreatment towards both his wife, and his son, Marcos respectively. This would be last time that Sebastian saw his son, Marcos, before he had died from his disease. Therefore, Sebastian and Marcos had parted ways on bad terms with each other, as well as the fact that, he had died all alone.

secbots.name: SecBots
secbots.origin: SecBots were bots stationed at the Valhalla Base and employed by NORAD as a defense force. They were used incase unauthorized personnel infiltrated the subterranean mountain base. They were employed, when Hellion member Empath revealed the presence of the X-Men in the base and used his empathy powers to manipulate the emotions of the general, which prompted the general to activate the SecBot alert and sent out the robots with the license to kill. The bots initially only managed to capture Nightcrawler and Rogue, they brought the duo to their general. But before they could find the rest of the mutant team, Nightcrawler used his teleport powers to escape captivity and subsequently extricated the rest of the team, which allowed them to evade capture and withdraw from the complex.

secco.name: Secco
secco.origin: Secco was a crew member aboard the Plasmagenians’ starship, commanded by Primo. The vessel was attacked by Reptyl—who had been transformed into a god‑like being by Thanos and was now seeking powerful individuals to form his own pantheon, Primo among them. When Reptyl breached the ship, Primo ordered Secco to deal with the hull rupture that had occurred. Later, when Thanos arrived on the Plasmagenian ship, he elevated Primo to a divine state by draining Secco’s life‑energy, killing him in the process.

second story sammy.name: Second-Story Sammy
second story sammy.origin: "Second-Story Sammy" was a robber who learned the secret identity of Giant-Man, when he found the hero unconscious in his apartment. Discovering his identity, he stole Pym's growing serum and costume and disguised himself as Giant-Man and started a wave of crime. He was pronto defeated by the Wasp and the true Giant-Man; then, the Giant-Man gave him a memory loss serum that made him forget not only Pym's identity but even Sammy's own past as a criminal.

seden karm.name: Seden Karm
seden karm.origin: At some point, Seden was indoctrinated by an unidentified Chlorite organization which sought to colonize Earth. He was one of ten Chlorites sent to infiltrate the planet and surgically removed his spines to disguise his appearance. Seden then travelled to Canton, Ohio and used a hypnotic device to implant false memories in a couple's mind to make them believe they were his abusive foster parents. He adopted the name John Chang and befriended Harry Mills. A month later, Charles Xavier detected Harry with Cerebro, he visited Canton and was surprised to find another apparent mutant. Sympathetic to John's history of abuse, he invited them both to the Xavier Institute. Xavier did not check John's foster care records or probe deep enough into his foster parents' minds to discover the truth. John and Harry became friends with a marginalized group of students whose mutations made them look strange or served as handicaps, including Meena Banerjee, Kristin Koenig, and Todd Watkins. At some point, Wolverine smelled chlorine on Seden but assumed it was from the swimming pool. Seden helped Meena to explore her powers in search of specific realities, comparing the nature of the universe to a bell curve. When Meena questioned how he knew so much about quantum waves, he claimed that he just liked to read ahead and learn on his own. When Wolverine once again smelled chlorine, now aware of the Chlorite threat, he quickly identified John as a Chlorite. Exposed, Seden mocked humanity's efforts to locate all the infiltrators and was taken into custody by the X-Men. He was tested by Hank McCoy in the laboratory and held at the Xavier Institute to be questioned with interference from the Diascar or the government. Seden continued to espouse the Chlorite rhetoric but Xavier was able to confuse him slightly by reminding him of his friends, Harry and Meena. After James Wheaton threatened to report Seden to the government, Meena, Harry, Kristin, Sarah Allaire, and Mike Galbraith plotted to help him escape and hide him elsewhere. When Rogue learned of their plans, she agreed to help them. The group was intercepted by the X-Men but they eventually agreed to protect Seden and seek a peaceful resolution. Shortly afterwards, Sentinels, Diascar, and the Imperial Guard arrived to collect Seden following Todd's tip to Henry Gyrich. John was eventually captured during the battle by Taforne's forces and transported to Poratine's command ship. When Seden was presented with the idea of an alternate reality where Chlorites could live in peace, he assured everyone that such a place was their goal and any terrorists would likely agree because, like him, they had believed there was no other choice. He offered to explore this proposed reality and assist with spreading the news to the remaining Chlorites on Earth if it proved to be viable.

sedna.name: Sedna
sedna.origin: thumb|left|150px|Sedna ===Origins and Ancient Times=== Sedna was the daughter of the Inua Sky Father Hodiak and the primordial Earth Mother Gaea. A beautiful goddess, Sedna spurned all those who sought her hand in marriage, until an humanoid avian in disguise enthralled her with her son, promising her in songs a luxurious life in his kingdom across the sea. Arriving there, Sedna discovered nature of her suitor and of his squalor. Sedna's father Hodiak eventually answered his daughter's desperate pleas for help and killed the captor/suitor. Facing the avenging humanoid avian's countrymen, Hodiak fled. Angered, Sedna attacked him, and he cursed her, banishing her to the northern seas' icy depths. There she began a lonely existence as the goddess of the dead. ===Modern Days=== In the more recent years, while wandering the North Atlantic, Sedna discovered a war ship lost by the Asgardian Gods. It impressed her, so she used its ruby gems to guide her to Thor as she wished to make Thor her mate, because she was lonely and wanted to marry a big, strong thunder god. During a brief clash with her own dragon, Thor accidentally reverted to his then mortal guise of 'Jake Olson' when it swallowed his hammer. It was rescued by Namor the Sub-Mariner who was unaware that Olson was in fact the thunder god. This distraction gave Thor enough time to recover his hammer and even help Namor force Sedna into retreat.
