sedrick.name: Sedrick
sedrick.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Circa 18,500 BC, Sedrick was a Valusian boy and squire to Maxmelle. Somehow, he was deceived by Thulsa Doom's tricks, enabling Beast-Men to overrun the castle keep . Brule the spear-slayer, the Pictish warrior of King Kull, intended to slay him, and his hand was stayed by Kull who recognized Sedrick as having been tricked by Thulsa Doom. Kull ordered Sedrick to rise and leave. ===Hyborian Age=== Circa 10,000 BC, Sedrick was acquired by Solaise in the catacombs beneath the temple of Mitra in Bhoraji. She constantly talked to him and he helped her access her dread powers. Sedrick allowed Solaise to experiment with her strange and potentially devastating powers, causing a freak sunburst in the middle of the night. He sensed the Devourer of Souls' presence and went after him. When Conan left the camp, General Freja ordered his men to kill Sedrick, since he hated cats, but Sedrick was eventually saved by Solaise, who unleashed her deadly powers, instantly killing Freja and all his men. As Conan and his one time ally Kaleb the Destroyer waged a pitched battle, Sedrick was summoned by the Devourer of Souls, who took him and Solaise to the Forest of the Eternal Verities, just to appear in his arms before the Cimmerian and the Aesir. As the forest eventually erupted in flames, Wrarrl, mounted on his winged steed, Solaise and Sedrick in the crook of his arm, flew off into the night sky, flaming sword held aloft. Riding upon his flying steed. the Devourer carried Solaise and Sedrick the Cat into Arallu, where Thulsa Doom related to him the origins of the cat. After inadvertently saving the life of Maxmelle, a knight of Valusia, the boy Sedrick was taken to the City of Wonders as his new squire. Sedrick settled into his new life, but was a lonely outcast amongst the other squires and thus easy prey for Thulsa Doom. Drawn into the evil mage’s schemes, and plotting with him for months, Sedrick was given the command to begin their plan. Drawing off the guards with a lie, Sedrick presented himself to King Kull. Using his shepherd’s staff, enchanted by Doom, to summon Beast-Men into the throneroom, Sedrick betrayed Valusia and Maxmelle, who had trusted him. Attempting to escape, Sedrick ran into Maxmelle and sobbed out the whole story. Maxmelle rushed off to defend his king and died in the battle. Brule was about to kill Sedrick for his treachery, but Kull stayed the Pict’s hand, knowing Thulsa Doom’s punishment for failure would be worse. Doom appeared and transformed the boy that betrayed him as well as Kull into an orange cat. Immortal, it would live until the end of the world. The Elder Gods, then decided the immortal cat Sedrick had become a much safer vessel in which to store their eldritch might. Thulsa Doom explained to the Devourer that the cat contained the power, but lacked the will to use it. Solaise had the will, but only a fraction of the power. On another plane of existence, the Devourer then began an unholy ritual involving Solaise, her cat Sedrick, and the Footslave. A wave of the 'white death' swept across the area on earth where Conan’s comrades awaited his return. This coincided with Sedrick being returned to human form. The Devourer said Sedrick could remain human on one condition: he must give the Devourer his power. When Conan finally defeated the Devourer of Souls, Sedrick appeared back to his original human form.

Kull ordered Sedrick to rise and leave. ===Hyborian Age=== Circa 10,000 BC, Sedrick was acquired by Solaise in the catacombs beneath the temple of Mitra in Bhoraji. She constantly talked to him and he helped her access her dread powers. Sedrick allowed Solaise to experiment with her strange and potentially devastating powers, causing a freak sunburst in the middle of the night. He sensed the Devourer of Souls' presence and went after him. When Conan left the camp, General Freja ordered his men to kill Sedrick, since he hated cats, but Sedrick was eventually saved by Solaise, who unleashed her deadly powers, instantly killing Freja and all his men. As Conan and his one time ally Kaleb the Destroyer waged a pitched battle, Sedrick was summoned by the Devourer of Souls, who took him and Solaise to the Forest of the Eternal Verities, just to appear in his arms before the Cimmerian and the Aesir. As the forest eventually erupted in flames, Wrarrl, mounted on his winged steed, Solaise and Sedrick in the crook of his arm, flew off into the night sky, flaming sword held aloft. Riding upon his flying steed. the Devourer carried Solaise and Sedrick the Cat into Arallu, where Thulsa Doom related to him the origins of the cat. After inadvertently saving the life of Maxmelle, a knight of Valusia, the boy Sedrick was taken to the City of Wonders as his new squire. Sedrick settled into his new life, but was a lonely outcast amongst the other squires and thus easy prey for Thulsa Doom. Drawn into the evil mage’s schemes, and plotting with him for months, Sedrick was given the command to begin their plan. Drawing off the guards with a lie, Sedrick presented himself to King Kull. Using his shepherd’s staff, enchanted by Doom, to summon Beast-Men into the throneroom, Sedrick betrayed Valusia and Maxmelle, who had trusted him. Attempting to escape, Sedrick ran into Maxmelle and sobbed out the whole story. Maxmelle rushed off to defend his king and died in the battle. Brule was about to kill Sedrick for his treachery, but Kull stayed the Pict’s hand, knowing Thulsa Doom’s punishment for failure would be worse. Doom appeared and transformed the boy that betrayed him as well as Kull into an orange cat. Immortal, it would live until the end of the world. The Elder Gods, then decided the immortal cat Sedrick had become a much safer vessel in which to store their eldritch might. Thulsa Doom explained to the Devourer that the cat contained the power, but lacked the will to use it. Solaise had the will, but only a fraction of the power. On another plane of existence, the Devourer then began an unholy ritual involving Solaise, her cat Sedrick, and the Footslave. A wave of the 'white death' swept across the area on earth where Conan’s comrades awaited his return. This coincided with Sedrick being returned to human form. The Devourer said Sedrick could remain human on one condition: he must give the Devourer his power. When Conan finally defeated the Devourer of Souls, Sedrick appeared back to his original human form.

seed of pain.name: Seed of Pain
seed of pain.origin: The Seed of Pain was a black druid who was being transferred from prison. It was possible that S.H.I.E.L.D., A.I.M. or even Roxxon wanted to weaponize his abilities. The mercenary group M.O.D.O.K. was hired to kill the Seed of Pain. His transport vehicle was damaged, and the Seed was abducted by Batroc the Leaper posing as a police officer. The agents of M.O.D.O.K. were then intercepted by Thor, who wanted to use the Seed's powers to erradicate an evil magical root from an Elven colony's island. During the ensuing confrontation between Thor and the agents of M.O.D.O.K., Gwenpool shot the Seed with a bazooka, killing him. The Seed's essence was captured by the Terrible Eye and Mega Tony, and turned into a magic weed killer, which was given to Thor to kill the magical root that troubled her allies.

seeker android.name: Seeker (Android)
seeker android.origin: The Seeker was an android created by Doctor Doom; only one Seeker was created. When the Fantastic Four escaped Doctor Doom's clutches with the help of their unlikely ally Darkoth before Doom could launch his Vibro-Bomb into orbit an enslave the Earth, the Seeker was dispatched to re-capture them. Although the Seeker knocked down Mr. Fantastic, it was then defeated by the combined effort of the Thing, Medusa and Darkoth. Later when the Fantastic Four attacked Doom's hideout, Darkoth disguised himself by wearing the Seeker's hull as a disguise. When he attacked Doctor Doom, the Latverian monarch blasted the Seeker armor off him. Although the Seeker was resolute, it was quickly defeated by the Thing, and Doom left it abandoned in his base. The Seeker robot has yet to be repaired or seen again.

seeker undead.name: Seeker (Undead)
seeker undead.origin: The Seeker was resurrected by Adam in a Nicaraguan temple to chose the next Ghost Rider. Alejandra, an 18-year-old girl, was chosen among Adam's many students and went to battle Skadi, who was laying waste to Dayton, Ohio. After her return, Adam ordered her to remove the sin from the rest of his students. Both Alejandra and the Seeker were against this, but Adam enslaved her and manipulated her powers. Johnny Blaze, the former Ghost Rider, traveled to Nicaragua to stop Adam. Despite working with the Seeker, they were unable to stop Adam from turning Alejandra into a bomb that erased the sin from everyone in Nicaragua, turning them into mindless, emotionless beings. Adam brought Alejandra to a space station equipped with a camera lens that would be able to magnify her powers across the entire Earth, eradicating sin from humanity. Johnny made an agreement with Mephisto in exchange for a bike that would bring him and the Seeker to space. But Johnny realized that the Seeker would use her as a weapon and ejected him from the bike, sending him back to Earth. Later on, Alejandra, hoping to give sin back to the Nicaraguans, went to the Seeker for help. The Seeker told her that Johnny Blaze was in contact with Mephisto and may be able to bring her to him. She tracked him down again and decapitated him, demanding he give her more power so that she can take on Mephisto. He reminds her that Adam is the one made her powerful in the first place and is not seen again.

seginn gallio.name: Seginn Gallio
seginn gallio.origin: ===Origin=== Born approximately 5.5 billion years before our time, Seginn Gallio was a member, later the last survivor, of one of the first intelligent species in the Universe. He filled his days, then his eons, with an obsessive study of astronomy, scouting and charting the astral bodies on it. This helped him not only to keep busy, but also to ensure his immortality. He soon lost interest in short-lived living beings. At some point before 4.5 billion years ago, Gallio met other immortal beings like himself, who were creating a council. Each of these Elders of the Universe had outlived his or her species and chosen one individual pursuit for their lives, believing that it gave them a reason to exist. As there are few beings in their Council, they call each other metaphorically brothers, albeit they are not really close to each other and have only their longevity as a common trait; only rarely they collaborate with other Elders. ===The Astronomer's great scheme to murder Galactus=== At some point after 4 billion years ago, the Elders discovered that Galactus, survivor of a previous universe, was a physical being even older than them, which offended their pride. Galactus was also an anomaly affecting the balance between Eternity and Death in their universe due to which, should Galactus be murdered, the whole universe would be destroyed - including the Elders. thumb|left|The Astronomer (second from the left) in the Earth meeting The Astronomer nonetheless conceived a strategy, with the help of fellow Elder Grandmaster for its implementation, The Astronomer looked for a way to survive the cataclysm that would destroy the universe, and indeed he found it: The Grandmaster played a game with Death on the life of the Elder known as Collector and lost; Death then punished him by barring all the Elders from her realm - like the Grandmaster and the Astronomer had intended. Now, if the Elders managed to kill Galactus, then the universe would collapse to nothing and a new Big Bang would happen. The Elders would then enter, reigning the new reality as the main powers and with Galactus-like power. The weapons to achieve the assassination were the Soul Gems, items of power that many believed destroyed. The Astronomer, knowing this to be exaggerated -fellow Elder Gardener had a gem on his forehead, albeit he was reluctant to provide it for this scheme-, talked about his conspiring with several Elders - not all of them- and sent them to get the gems. Indeed, the Collector got one of the gems thanks to Grandmaster's bet; the Champion won another gem by defeating the challengers of the planet Grinx; the Trader negotiated for two other gems; and the Contemplator (really a Skrull impersonating him) was sent to the planet Kree-Lar to get the last gem from the Supreme Intelligence. The Elders sent the Champion to Earth in an attempt to murder the heroic Silver Surfer, whom the Astronomer had correctly identified as a threat to the plan. When the Champion failed, the Surfer escaped Earth, and harassed the Collector for information, leaving empty-handed. The Collector then sent fellow Elder Runner to kill the Surfer; the Runner failed and worse: A Cotati plant in the Collector's collection reported solid information to vegetable-empathic super heroine Mantis, who allied with the Surfer to stop this plan. The Elders arranged a number of secret meetings to discuss the progress on their plan and to report to some other Elders who were still unaware of it -apparently Obliterator, Possessor, Runner, and Ego the Living Planet, who literally hosted the first meeting. Mantis led the Surfer there to spy. They discovered parts of the Astronomer's scheme, and promptly decided to oppose to it, but Ego detected the Surfer and Mantis. The more physical Elders -not including Astronomer- tried to capture the intruders, but these escaped. Although the Elders sent the Obliterator to kill them, he also failed and, humiliated, explained the details of their plan and revealed the time and location of the following Elder meeting: Autumn Equinox, Earth -a planet that Galactus had sworn to never attack. Mantis went to spy that encounter alone, as the Surfer had to answer an emergency call from his native planet Zenn-La. On Earth, the Elders noticed that the attendees did not include the Contemplator, still on mission to get a gem per the Astronomer's words, nor the Obliterator. Some Elders, including the Astronomer and the Elder, considered that the Obliterator may had been defeated; the Runner and the Champion supported their absent peer. Then the Gardener illustrated the gems and used his nature-controlling powers to detect and capture Mantis! Understanding that the Surfer was likely to be alive and free, the Elders sent the Gardener to kidnap the Surfer's former fiancée Shalla-Bal, empress of Zenn-La, who was getting too close to the truth of their plan again thanks to those meddlesome Cotati. The Contemplator failed to negotiate the last gem with then

He filled his days, then his eons, with an obsessive study of astronomy, scouting and charting the astral bodies on it. This helped him not only to keep busy, but also to ensure his immortality. He soon lost interest in short-lived living beings. At some point before 4.5 billion years ago, Gallio met other immortal beings like himself, who were creating a council. Each of these Elders of the Universe had outlived his or her species and chosen one individual pursuit for their lives, believing that it gave them a reason to exist. As there are few beings in their Council, they call each other metaphorically brothers, albeit they are not really close to each other and have only their longevity as a common trait; only rarely they collaborate with other Elders. ===The Astronomer's great scheme to murder Galactus=== At some point after 4 billion years ago, the Elders discovered that Galactus, survivor of a previous universe, was a physical being even older than them, which offended their pride. segismund joshua.name: Segismund Joshua
segismund joshua.origin: Dr. Segismund Joshua was a human scientist that worked at Ophrah Industries, and experimented on former New Mutants team member Roberto Da Costa aka Sunspot under the orders of company owner Gideon. He took Roberto's genetic material and injected it into Project Nineteen, a mutant that from birth existed as a protoplasmic body. With the genetic material as a template it regenerated into a mirror image of Roberto. Though Dr. Joshua didn't want Gideon to know of the success of Project Nineteen, it remains unknown of how much Gideon knew. Nineteen escaped from Gideon's lab, killing five people, and taking the name Reignfire. After the apparent death of Gideon, Dr. Joshua came to work for the Damocles Foundation. He and his colleagues, Doctor Ogada and Doctor Chandra awoke Ekatarina Gryaznova from her coma, allowing Bastion to transform her into a Prime Sentinel. When Domino was captured by Gryaznova, Joshua and his colleagues placed a device in Domino's nervous system while studying Meltdown, Rictor, and Shatterstar when they were prisoners of Operation: Zero Tolerance. Joshua later attempted to confront Reignfire after he escaped from custody by zapping him with a molecular disruptor. However, the disruptor had little effect on Reignfire, and Reignfire retaliated by setting Joshua on fire. Joshua managed to put the fire out and tried sneaking away, but Siryn from X-Force found him and forced him to explain his connection to Reignfire. After helping X-Force defeat Reignfire, Joshua was handed over to S.H.I.E.L.D. Joshua eventually returned to the Damocles Foundation and helped Doctor Chandra take the remains of Reignfire and attach him to a Celestial Gatherer to function as a solar battery, which would awaken the Gatherer for the Damocles Foundation's purposes. Joshua was concerned that Reignfire would cause the Gatherer to go out of control while Chandra was confident that nanite safeguards would assure that the Gatherer would make it controllable. However, Selene took control of the Gatherer, forcing Arcadia DeVille and Moonstar of X-Force to destroy it. Joshua's whereabouts and fate are unknown after that.

seidring.name: Seidring
seidring.origin: Seidring the Merciless was the highest-ranked of Odin's council. When Thor revealed his secret identity to Jane Foster, Odin did not have the heart to punish Thor himself, so he transferred his power to Seidring. Seidring was overcome with lust at the power given to him and instead of returning the power to Odin, turned against the Asgardian All-Father and declared himself new master over Asgard. He was defeated by Thor who threatened to use the Odinsword, preferring to destroy all Asgardians rather than having them under the rule of an usurper.

seiji honda.name: Seiji Honda
seiji honda.origin: A quiet young boy, all Seiji Honda wanted to do was play with his action figures. Unfortunately, his monstrous stepfather Noboru disrupted this by beating his mother Ikeda. Though he'd promised his mother he would never reveal his mutant powers, Noboru found out about them and intended to send Seiji away. When Ikaeda tried to stop him, Noboru threatened her. In order to save his mother's life, Seiji animated all of his action figures at once and send them on his cruel stepfather. This proved insufficient to stop Noboru, who cornered the boy on the balcony of their apartment. Noboru made a desperate lunge, and he and Seiji fell over the edge. The fall killed Noboru and left Seiji paralyzed from the neck down. Since then, Seiji's only means of communicating has been through his action figures. Whether he has retained this ability after M-Day is unrevealed.

sekmeht conoway.name: Sekmeht Conoway
sekmeht conoway.origin: Sekmeht Anubar (later Conoway) was the daughter of archeologist Anwar Anubar. When she was a teenager, she entered a temple in Egypt's Valley of Kings, leading to an encounter with Ozymandias. At some point, her father would put his wife - Sekmeht's mother - into suspended animation. She would later join her father at Elysian Enterprises, helping to find either the schematics or a working piece of an ancient extraterrestrial vessel, said to have extended the life of Chinese ruler, Garbha-Hsien. Over the course of four years, Sekmeht and Elysian Enterprises tracked down 11 of 12 temples built to Hsien's children. In the eighth tomb, they uncovered a scroll detailing unique safeguards within each temple. Upon locating the twelfth, attempts to enter were thwarted by these safeguards. However, Gambit effortlessly slipped through the traps to steal the guarded item - a type of highly advance gauntlet. The Elysian Guards attempted to intercept Gambit and capture him, but he fled, knocking Sekmeht from a high platform in the ensuing battle. Acting quickly, Gambit managed to catch her in time, introducing himself and charming the archeologist - a memory later exploited by Fontanelle. Sekmeht later encountered Gambit again when her father sent her after the Momentary Princess, a mysterious "jewel" that appeared in the same place in Leipzig, Germany every 27-29 years for a few minutes and offered glimpses into the past and future. They were not the only two after the Momentary Princess: The children of Baron von Strucker, who had originally discovered the Princess during World War I, were also after the jewel. However, Sekmeht, Andrea, and Andreas von Strucker failed to take into account Earth's orbital drift, leading to Gambit reaching the jewel first. A fight ensued, and none of the interested parties were able to claim it. Later, Gambit and Sekmeht found themselves competing once again, this time for the Tomorrow Stone, which Gambit needed to help a de-aging Spat and Sekmeht needed to save her mother from her suspended animation. Sekmeht ultimately obtained the Tomorrow Stone, but chose to give it to Spat to save her life. Sekmeht set out once more to search for another solution to help her mother. ===The Sunset Dawn=== It wasn't long before Gambit went to her with another favor, this time for help figuring out how to travel through time. The reason the Thieves Guild had sent Gambit after the Momentary Princess was because they possessed a picture of the current Gambit living in 1891. Jean-Luc LeBeau and Tante Mattie detailed how Gambit somehow managed to travel through time and affect both their lives and how Anwar Anubar helped Baron von Strucker locate the jewel in the past. Along with the face changing Mutant the Courier and the Mengo Brothers, Sekmeht and Gambit headed deep into Latveria to use the time traveling devices in Doctor Doom's castle. However, upon entering the castle, Sekmeht ran into several Doombots. They fled deeper into the castle until Sekmeht managed to locate the Time Platform. Working quickly as the Doombots closed in, she set Gambit's coordinates for London, 1891. Before he teleported, Gambit grabbed the Courier and commanded the Mengo Brothers to protect Sek, which they demonstrated in the ensuing battle against the Doombots. However, she was unable to set up a retrieval for Gambit and the Courier, resulting in the two being stuck in the past. Sekmeht and the Mengo brothers managed to steal a transport and escape, but crashed near the Viscayan Mountains that bordered Latveria and Symkaria. They hid in the Folding City, a place of spatial anomaly, where they remained trapped for at least six weeks. Rogue followed the group to Doomstadt after hearing of Gambit's disappearance. She confronted Anwar, who provided her with tech locked on to Sekmeht's genetic tag. Rushing off to the Stryfe-controlled Latveria, Rogue located Sek and the Mengo brothers in the Folding City where they had been on the run from Verherrglichenn, the Exalted One, the former head of security at the lab before it was consumed by an anomaly and became the Folding City. While attempting to escape, the Exalted One grabbed Rogue's leg to try and drag her back into the Folding City, with Sekmeht trying to pull her free. Grigori Mengo severed his arm and one of his reality-warping gauntlets, trapping Verherrglichenn and the other scientists forever. Gambit managed return to the present not long afterwards. Sekmeht informed him about events that unfolded in the Folding City, which he thanked Rogue for when they reunited at JFK Airport.

Rushing off to the Stryfe-controlled Latveria, Rogue located Sek and the Mengo brothers in the Folding City where they had been on the run from Verherrglichenn, the Exalted One, the former head of security at the lab before it was consumed by an anomaly and became the Folding City. While attempting to escape, the Exalted One grabbed Rogue's leg to try and drag her back into the Folding City, with Sekmeht trying to pull her free. Grigori Mengo severed his arm and one of his reality-warping gauntlets, trapping Verherrglichenn and the other scientists forever. Gambit managed return to the present not long afterwards. Sekmeht informed him about events that unfolded in the Folding City, which he thanked Rogue for when they reunited at JFK Airport.

He managed to free himself but was swiftly slain by Namor.

selah burke.name: Selah Burke
selah burke.origin: Selah Burke was infected with the Carrion Virus after coming into contact with William Allen. She suffered from the virus until she met Spider-Man. After a brief battle with him, Spider-Man healed her of the virus. After her encounter with Spider-Man, she decided to take up her own super-powered identity as Sun Girl. She went after the Wrecking Crew, who were robbing a major company but she lost due to her inexperience. Right when the battle was going to be over, Spider-Man and his new team interrupted. Now with the advantage they fought until the Wrecking Crew fled and Sun Girl was unconscious. When she woke up, she found herself in Spider-Man's lair and he questioned her about identity and origin. After she worked with Spider-Man and his Superior Six, they found the villain Lightmaster. He planned to use a device to create giant spheres of chaos using his light based powers. He teamed with the Masters of Evil to cause a distraction for Spider-Man and his friends. During the fight, Selah realized she got her suit which is the source of her powers from her dad, Lightmaster. Selah was now torn between siding with her idol Spider-Man, or her father. In the end, she chose Spider-Man and dealt the finishing blow to Lightmaster's plan. She used her light based powers to destroy his device and, by doing so, created much chaos. The chaos was short lived, but was very impactful. Not only was Selah rendered unconscious, but Spider-Man lost control of his team and they retaliated against him for his unethical use of mind control to get what he wanted. When she awoke, she became aware of what had happened and went off to find Spider-Man and help him maintain the situation. However, she had a whole new perspective on his personality. They were eventually able to stop them, all thanks to Selah.

selena ciscernos.name: Selena Ciscernos
selena ciscernos.origin: The population of Almost Reno, New Mexico, were rendered sterile by atomic tests. In an effort to control mutantkind, Odysseus Indigo's Damocles Foundation approached them, and offered to return their ability to have children. The Damocles Foundation injected the townspeople with both mutant and deviant DNA, which restored their fertility and ensured that any of their children would be born superhuman, and thus ideal test subjects for Indigo. One of these children was Selena Ciscernos, who had the ability to shapeshift. At age eight, she was in a car accident with her parents, in which they were killed and she severely wounded. At the hospital, her doctors denied the Damocles Foundation permission to take custody of her. They introduced her to Domino of X-Force, who were investigating the mysteries of Almost Reno. Selena succumbed to her injuries not long after.

selena slate.name: Selena Slate
selena slate.origin: Selena Slate was the lab assistant to Dr. Charles Warren Fong. Fong was working on an experiments with light using a synthetic diamond. Slate conspired with her boyfriend, Garth, to steal the diamond. Both of their attempts to steal the diamond were disrupted by Sleepwalker, who had become addicted to the light generated through the diamond. Grasping the diamond while it was still irradiated with light, Slate became empowered as Spectra. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, she was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

selene gallio.name: Selene Gallio
selene gallio.origin: ===Hyborian Age=== Selene was born 17,000 years ago in central Europe, "after the Oceans swallowed Atlantis" and "before the rise of the sons of Aryas". Selene's mother was young when she bore her, but would be dead before Selene spoke her first words. Born with strange powers that caused her to drain the life of those around her, the tribal elders ordered her mother's people to sacrifice themselves to Selene until none remained. They thus gave her sustenance and her name. ===Rome=== thumb|right During the times of the Roman Empire, Selene began plotting to sacrifice the entire population of Rome in a ceremony that would grant her godlike power. To further this scheme, she recruited Eliphas, a respected Roman senator, who was unaware that he had been brought to power by people who wished to use him. After his fall from grace, Selene came to him, offering him her eternal love and immortality - if he helped her sacrifice the countless souls of Rome. She instructed her pawn to draw symbols around the city in his own blood for the ritual. However, Eliphas performed a small act of compassion by telling a slave girl he had previously saved from starvation what was going to happen. Her father informed the authorities, who captured both Eliphas and Selene and sentenced them to be burned at the stake. Selene awoke before it could happen and set the flames back against their would-be executioners. Furious at Eliphas for seemingly betraying her, she took his life-force and transformed him into a vampire-like creature, vowing that he would never see her again. ===Across the Ages=== In the 12th century, Selene, disguised as a nun, allied herself with Burke, Crule, Apocalypse, and Nicodemus to establish the Externals. Together, they conducted a ritual, fulfilling Candra's request by transferring her life essence into a stone. Centuries ago, Selene acquired a case containing the potent Asgardian Runestaff of Yggdrasil. She foresaw a moment when the alignment of the Nine Realms would empower the artifact, requiring the blood of an Asgardian to unlock its full potential. During World War II, Selene collaborated with Alexa Lukin to siphon the life force from Peggy Carter. Subsequently, Selene found residence among the inhabitants of Nova Roma, a society tracing its roots to the Roman Empire, nestled in the depths of the Brazilian rainforest. ===Modern Times=== thumb|left|150px Selene posed as an Incan in the hidden city of Nova Roma and found worshippers as the Dark Priestess. She was discovered by the New Mutants trying to sacrifice Amara Aquilla, and learned for the first time that other beings with powers existed. Sunspot imprisoned her, but Selene escaped soon thereafter. Intrigued by seeing the young heroes use their powers, Selene traveled to New York City. In New York, Selene seduced Cain Marko in a bar, hoping to absorb his life force, but was indirectly prevented by the X-Men who happened upon Rachel Summers when sensing her immense power. She attempted to drain her life-force, but was stopped by the X-Men. Soon after, Selene became interested in the Hellfire Club and tried to join its Inner Circle with help from her worshiper Friedrich von Roehm. Sensing Rachel Summers and Magma nearby, she defeated them and offered them as gifts to the Club. While the adolescents were rescued by the X-Men, Selene was admitted and given the position of Black Queen. However, it was clear that Sebastian Shaw was frightened by the witch despite their association. Selene developed a rivalry with the White Queen Emma Frost. thumb|right|150px When Kulan Gath transformed all of Manhattan into a Hyborian Age land, Selene was unaffected by the dark sorcerer's spell. It was revealed that she was an old enemy of Gath: the two had feuded long ago during the actual Hyborian Age. Selene's spells caused Storm and Callisto to remember Gath was an enemy, eventually leading to his defeat. Rachel Summers plotted to kill Selene and the other members of the Hellfire Club after recovering the memories of the Phoenix Force, whom she believed to be her mother. Having drained the X-Men's life-forces temporarily to battle the Beyonder, the spirit of Wolverine was drawn into her dreams, where he learned her intentions. Rachel confronted Selene in her room at the club, and was about to kill her when Wolverine arrived. He tried to reason with the young X-Man, and when she attempted to carry on, he stabbed her through the heart with his claws, saving Selene. Joined by Sebastian Shaw, Harry Leland, and Friedrich von Roehm, Selene sought revenge for Rachel's attack. Encountering the X-Men in Central Park, the two groups clashed, even though the Hellfire Club were outnumbered by the heroes. Selene proved herself in combat by disintegrating Rogue's gloves as she tried to save Colossus from Leland's density-altering power. To both teams' surprise, the time-displaced mutant hunter Nimrod appeared, declaring that they were all viable targets. Within moments the robot

fields.notes: Selene appears to age as she uses magic, especially when she over-exerts herself. As an External and her immortality becoming active upon her first death, she does not age, but she has been seen to temporarily age when overexerting her other powers or been injured. Whether this temporary state is an effect of the overexertion/injury or her briefly returning to her true age at the time she met her first death remains unknown.
fields.trivia: Selene was originally introduced as being of Incan descent, although that has since been retconned. The former Hellion Firestar was originally trained by the White Queen for the purpose of assassinating Selene. The main character Selene in the Underworld series is based on her. She appears as a protagonist in New Mutants Forever. At over 17,000 years old, she is one of the oldest known mutants on the planet (more on the first mutants here). The name "Selene" is Greek in origin. Selene was the Greek name of both the Moon (the natural satellite of the Earth) and the personifying it. The Roman equivalent of Selene was Luna.

selig.name: Selig
selig.origin: Selig and his wife birthed Kologoth Antares. The baby suffered a genetic mutation, giving him a demonic appearance. Because of this, Selig and his wife rejected the child. Slig took Kologoth to the outskirts of the city to kill him, but abandoned him instead, lacking the determination to murder his own son. Many years later, when Kologoth Antares returned to society as an adult, he tracked down his parents and murdered them. Selig fainted at the mere sight of Kologoth, and was then beheaded.

selwyn james.name: Selwyn James
selwyn james.origin: Thirty years ago Selwyn worked for Doc Croc and attacked Britannia, alongside Volcanna and Lady Shimmering Lights. He was able to surprise and overpower her. He began working for the British government and was in charge of the Britannia Project. When The Choir went missing he, Union Jack, and Bulldog responded. They were attacked by a shapeshifter named Shifter and Selwyn allowed himself to be taken hostage. When Shifter realised that Selwyn used to work for Doc Croc, Selwyn killed him.

semele.name: Semele
semele.origin: ===Origin=== Semele was the daughter of King Cadmus of Thebes and Harmonia. At some point, she had a relationship with Zeus, who impregnated her and sworn to grant her her every wish. Tricked by Zeus' jealous wife Hera, she asked Zeus to reveal himself to her in all his glory and perished, "as any mortal would, in the divine blaze", on top of Mount Pramnos, Doliche (modern-day Icaria, Greece). Her son Dionysus was born there, rescued by Hermes at the behest of Zeus. He was delivered to the Hyades who raised him on Mount Nysa and gave him the food of the gods and was eventually reunited with his father atop Mount Olympus. ===Return=== Upon learning his mother's fate, Dionysus traveled to Hades, freed her and brought her to Olympus where she was apotheosized as the goddess Thyone. ===Modern days=== Apparently back to being a captive in Hades, Semele was summoned by Pluto during the trial of Zeus, Pluto using the tale of her death as an argument on his side to prove the callousness of his brother. Semele was then taken away by Hades' guards.

semijan.name: Semijan
semijan.origin: Semijan the Undying possessed Randall Shire, who ran a small traveling carnival in Australia, and enslaved Key and his brother Wall with his mutant vocal power. Key was forced to serve Shire, but still managed to alert Clarity, an enigmatic source of the mutant hero Cable's journalist friend Irene Merryweather, of Semijan's plans for Shire. After Cable stopped an assassination attempt on Shire by another Undying known as Aentaros and discredited Shire in the eyes of those he'd enslaved, thus freeing them from his control, Key and his brother aided Cable in breaking into the Undying's stronghold. It was Key who reprogrammed the Undying's artificial intelligence program causing them to be unable to possess anything except cockroaches for the rest of eternity.

Ch'kra fell ill on Earth, and the aliens abducted humans in order to harness their bio-energy and heal the Prince. But after capturing Dr. Strange, they were easily defeated by the Defenders summoned by Strange's astral form and rather than being captured, believing that the Defenders were allies of the Emperor, they preferred to commit suicide.

semiramis.name: Semiramis
semiramis.origin: ===Origin and early years=== After Zarathos was defeated by the supernatural Blood about twenty-five millennia ago, some among the Blood began worshiped Zarathos, and became known as the Fallen, with Salomé being one of the most powerful in their midst. Salomé was possibly the ancestor or the namesake of the millennia-old line of sorceresses of the same name, including Salomé and Taramis, twin sisters from the Hyborian Age of Conan (circa 10,000 BC). Circa the 13th century BC she became the Sorceress Supreme, by her own account the first denizen of Earth to do so. She presumably protected Earth's dimension from various threats, but her ego demanded that she be worshiped as a goddess, which she received in the Assyrian city of Nimrud. According to legends, the Sorceress Queen Serimaris heard of the fame of the fame of King Ara of Armenia and used the Orb of Agamotto to see him and instantly feel in love. As he refused to marry her, she marched against Armenia with the armies of Assyria. During the battle, possibly set in the Ararat Valley, Ara was killed. She consequently decreed that Ara would be worshiped as a god and herself as a goddess, and was consequently worshiped as a goddess in the city Nimrud. Circa 1100 BC, her actions led to the displeasement of the Vishanti, who banished her and her fellow Fallen were banished to another dimension, while the role of Sorcerer Supreme apparently fell to a sorcerer on another planet within Earth's universe. ===Modern Age=== In recent history, Salomé set the Fallen loose and began attacking Doctor Strange, the then-current Sorcerer Supreme, through a series of psychic assaults channeled via Nightmare's realm, as she couldn't access Earth directly. She soon aligned with the Midnight Sons against Lilith and her demonic Lilin. When a surge of energy meant for Zarathos was released, Salomé redirected it and used it to bond with Earth's biosphere, entering the mortal realm through the occult hotspot at Cypress Hills Cemetery. Upon reaching the Sanctum Sanctorum, she challenged Doctor Strange for the mantle of Sorcerer Supreme. Weakened from their brief conflict, Strange relinquished the title and retreated into a null-space dimension to restore his strength. There, he fashioned two constructs, Strange and Victor Stevens, unaware that Salomé's corrupt magic had infected both. Intent on restoring her dominion, Salomé disguised herself as a scholar to begin recruiting new followers. While she expanded her influence, Modred the Mystic manipulated Morbius, Werewolf, and Vengeance into confronting Salomé's agents. Lured to Cypress Hills once more, Salomé fought the Midnight Sons but fled. Drawing power from her growing cult, she sought Doctor Strange and instead encountered the doppelganger Strange, who was gathering mystical items around the globe. One such search led to a clash with Namor, and Salomé tried to overwhelm Namor with the collective emotions of Atlantis. However, Vengeance disrupted her spell, allowing Strange to escape. Back in her ancient citadel in Assyria, now part of Iraq, Salomé launched the Shrieking Rain Jihad, spreading chaos and fear through terror tactics. She captured the second construct, Vincent Stevens, prompting Strange to use Stevens as a vessel to confront her while remaining hidden in null-space. Their magic, nearly indistinguishable, created a stalemate. As Doctor Strange struggled with his now-hostile doppelgangers—eventually destroying one and banishing the other—Salomé continued her schemes, monitoring the Midnight Sons and enlisting Diabolique, an enemy of Vengeance, as a prospective student. She later called upon the Vishanti, whose support Strange had declined. Empowered by their might, Salomé breached Strange's null-space refuge. Despite his exhaustion, Strange managed to momentarily banish her limbs to scattered dimensions, weakening her enough to call upon the same biosphere-based magic she had once absorbed. This final act led to the destruction or banishment of his corrupted forerunner, ending her threat — at least for the time being. Salomé ended up in the Dark Dimension, but as a great horror was coming, she returned in New York City, intending to steal the Heart-Shaped Herbs-powered eyes of Zawadi of the Monster Hunters. she was tracked down by the Forgiven, and was also witnessed by Spider-Man, who followed her as she broke into Zawadi's apartment. There, she ambushed Spider-Man but was surprised by the Forgiven. Salomé corrupted Spider-Man, causing him to attack the Forgiven, until Raiko Kodo broke her hold over him. Using a spear with a Nephilim bone tip and bathed in the red radiation of the Hellfire Helix. Zawadi then drew a circle around the convulsing Salomé, who burst in green flames.

sen dor.name: Sen-Dor
sen dor.origin: Sen-Dor was a sorcerer of Kamelia who was introduced to King Kull of Valusia by Tu, to help him solve the great calamity which was cursing the City of Wonders. Despite his poor results, Kull eventually decided to take Sen-Dor with his court to the campaign against the Zarfhaanans. sen yu.name: Sen-Yu
sen yu.origin: Sen-Yu had been healed by the Ancient One in the past and unsuccessfully tried to become his disciple. Sen-Yu was in charge of managing part of the Ancient One's sizeable monetary assets. Some years later, Baron Mordo used power from Dormammu to attack the Ancient One and his disciple Doctor Strange. Leaving the Ancient One in a safe place with Hamir the Hermit, Strange left and sought out Sen-Yu for help. Sen-Yu gladly provided Strange with clothes, money, and a passport; soon after, he met Strange in the street and discreetly gave him a plane ticket. Years later, Sen-Yu, Wai Chee Yee and several other wizards were invited to the Temple of the Three for the Sorcerer Supreme contest. Both were defeated but saved when Doctor Strange solved the test.

senator boynton.name: Senator Boynton
senator boynton.origin: Senator Boyton and Edwin Cord agreed to complete Project Firepower and eliminate Iron Man. He and some men from the Defense Department convinced Tony Stark to help destroy Iron Man, inadvertently giving away an ambush that they have set for Iron Man using Firepower. After some follow-up tests on the Firepower armor, Boynton and General Meade wanted to take custody of the armor, but Cord refused to give it to them, menacing to tell people how Firepower was conceived as the ultimate weapon in riot control, to be used against citizens in cases of extreme civil disorder.

senator doaks.name: Senator Doaks
senator doaks.origin: thumb|left|Senator Doaks Senator Doaks was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. By the spring of 1944, he had managed to infiltrate the United States government as a Senator. When operating as a spy, he wore a life-like mask to disguise his identity and was known as the "Brain". When the Allied Forces were gaining ground in the liberation of Italy, Adolf Hitler personally ordered the Brain to sabotage American defense factories in order to reduce the amount of munitions being used in the war effort. After a string of successful attacks, the Human Torch and Toro to begin searching for the source of the sabotage. When the Torch and Toro prevented the Brain's men from blowing up Stone Valley Dam, the Brain prepared a trap for the heroes. As they searched Washington, D.C., the Brain let loose a carrier pigeon with a note written by his civilian identity of Senator Doaks agreeing to "meet" with the Brain at his home at 8 o'clock that night to negotiate a cease in the destruction. When the Torch and Toro flew through the window of Doak's home, they soon found that the glass had been replaced with a fire proof rubber that snuffed out their flames. The Brain and his men then took the Torch and Toro to the Bolton Steel Works. He then dumped the Torch and Toro into a vat of molten steel. The heroes survived the attempt, and after rounding up the Brain's men and disabling the bomb, they chased after the Brain. When the Brain attempted to light a stick of TNT, the Torch tossed a fireball at him, causing the Brain to stumble over a railing and fell to his death. When the Torch examined the body, the Brain was unmasked and his true identity revealed.

seni karlan.name: Seni Karlan
seni karlan.origin: Seni Karlan was a jewel collector who was active in the 1940s. Determined to do anything to get the jewels he sought, he resorted to theft in order to obtain the so called Karlan Sapphire. What connection the sapphire had to Karlan, or if he superficially named it after himself, is unknown. He sought out the jewel because if a specific light was filtered through it, it could cause temporary blindness in anyone whom it was trained on. When the original owner of the sapphire sent a couple to reclaim it, Karlan caught them in the act of trying to switch the original with a fake and held them at gunpoint. Using the special lamp, Karlan made the male of the duo go blind, but was then attacked when the Vision materialized. The Vision was temporarily sent away when Karlan tossed the lamp at Vision, and the smoke from the electrical surge caused the hero to be briefly shunted back to his dimension. Returning again, the Vision grabbed the lamp and tossed it at Seni who was electrocuted upon impact with his lamp. The stolen Karlan Sapphire was returned to its original owner.

senso.name: Senso
senso.origin: ===Early Life=== Senso was born among a secluded community of Human and Inhuman hybrids whose ancestors had left the Great Refuge of Attilan after their powers of persuasion caused fear and distrust among other Inhumans. Settling in remote, undiscovered mountains, these hybrids lived in isolation and intermarried with local Humans, producing children who all manifested some form of mental influence or perception-distorting ability, including Senso's own talent for vocal persuasion and psionic control. ===Enslavement=== Legends about this hidden tribe eventually reached Nazi Germany, prompting an expedition led by Erik Jaggar into the mountains. Jaggar's troops massacred the adults of Senso’s village and seized the children as valuable assets for the Reich, transporting them to Berlin as part of a program that would later be known as Project Loki. In captivity, Senso and the other children were brutalised, indoctrinated and trained as potential weapons, their powers tested and refined through torture and combat drills. Even at a young age Senso emerged as a natural leader, using her persuasion and sheer force of will to resist their handlers and to organise the other captives, often causing the deaths or breakdowns of the guards who underestimated them. ===Birth of the Hidden Ones=== As the World War II neared its end, the Human Torch and Toro incinerated Adolf Hitler in his bunker, plunging Berlin into chaos and shattering the Nazi regime that held Senso and her people. Taking advantage of the confusion, the hybrid children escaped into the devastated city. Under Senso's guidance, they swore a collective oath that they would never again live as slaves and would ensure that their people could never be hunted so easily. They adopted the name Hidden Ones, vowing to conceal their existence by infiltrating the power structures of the Human world and using their powers to steer events from the shadows. Over the following decades Senso and her fellows quietly placed members in governments, militaries, intelligence agencies, media outlets and religious institutions, always avoiding overt exposure while nudging policy and opinion to keep their kind safe. Senso herself became one of their foremost operatives, mastering multiple identities and perfecting the use of glamour-like perception effects to present different faces to different audiences. ===Manipulating the Thing=== In the modern era Senso targeted Ben Grimm as part of a long-term operation involving the Grey Gargoyle. Appearing in New York City as an alluring, dark-haired woman in a nightgown, she approached a despondent Ben in a Yancy Street bar, gently drawing out his insecurities and regrets while subtly clouding his judgment with her powers. A kiss left him briefly dazed and entranced, and when he recovered she had already slipped away. Soon after, the Grey Gargoyle attacked civilians on the Brooklyn Bridge, turning bystanders to stone. Senso shadowed the battle, watching Ben struggle against the villain. At a critical moment her presence distracted Ben long enough for the Gargoyle to touch him, petrifying the Thing into a stone statue while she remained outwardly uninvolved. When the Fantastic Four teleported to the bridge from their orbital base, Senso quietly withdrew, leaving the team to defeat the Gargoyle. Although the Gargoyle was captured and his victims restored, Ben's condition remained anomalous, and later notes identified the mystery woman behind the attack as Senso of the Hidden Ones. ===Infiltrating the United States Government=== As global tensions with alien races and the Inhumans increased, Senso assumed the guise of a blonde, high-ranking aide within the United States military and intelligence apparatus. From this position she helped design and promote anti-alien defense initiatives, including orbital “alien defense” satellites and hard-line policies that framed all non-Human beings as potential invaders. Reed Richards was summoned to a secure facility to consult with generals and officials about these programs. While Reed argued that many aliens had defended Earth and warned that blanket xenophobia would repeat Humanity's worst prejudices, Senso remained outwardly deferential, allowing fear-driven arguments to dominate the discussion while discreetly reinforcing those sentiments with Hidden One persuasion. In parallel, agents of the Hidden Ones within the media fanned public hysteria, and an ostensibly peaceful press event with the Inhumans at the Baxter Building devolved into a violent, xenophobic riot that further justified harsh measures. ===Seizing Ben Grimm=== Tracking energy traces from an earlier alien incident, Ben followed a trail into a back alley and stumbled upon a squad of Guardsmen using specialised weaponry that interfered with his restored ability to shift between his Human and Thing forms. From this position she helped design and promote anti-alien defense initiatives, including orbital “alien defense” satellites and hard-line policies that framed all non-Human beings as potential invaders. Reed Richards was summoned to a secure facility to consult with generals and officials about these programs. While Reed argued that many aliens had defended Earth and warned that blanket xenophobia would repeat Humanity's worst prejudices, Senso remained outwardly deferential, allowing fear-driven arguments to dominate the discussion while discreetly reinforcing those sentiments with Hidden One persuasion. sentinel daria.origin: A Prime Sentinel that looked like a young teenage girl with her head shaved who helped Bastion conduct Operation: Zero Tolerance. She eventually switched sides, deciding to help Jubilee escape. thumb|left|Daria escaping with Jubilee Daria couldn't stand to see Jubilee tortured by Bastion because, as Jubilee reasoned to her, they were both "freaks." Daria flew Jubilee out of her place of detention, which was the New Mexico base called "Hulkbuster Base." Daria flew out of sight, determined to keep the Sentinels distracted as Jubilee got away, which is the last time she was seen. It's unknown whether the Sentinels finished her off or if she somehow got away.

sentinel juston.name: Sentinel (Juston)
sentinel juston.origin: ===Origin=== During a campaign for the Senate, Jeff Knudsen needed to eliminate his competition, Richardson, so he employed the help of a longtime friend and high ranking military leader Archie Hunt. Together Knudsen and Hunt plotted to use Hunt's military connections to send a Sentinel out to kill Richardson then self-destruct thereby destroying any evidence. The plot would result in Knudsen getting his senate seat then promoting Hunt to the rank of Colonel. However, after dropping Richardson into Lake Michigan, the Sentinel crashed in the Seyfert Salvage junkyard in Antigo, Wisconsin. left|200px|thumb|Juston first meets his Sentinel ===Juston Seyfert=== The Sentinel remained broken and undisturbed until Juston Seyfert discovered a control chip and inadvertently activated the unit's self-repair mode. After discovering the semi-operational Sentinel, Juston began helping to rebuild and reprogram him. Usually this wouldn't have worked as Sentinels were impossible to be reprogrammed, but this particular Sentinel allowed Juston to change its programming possibly due to seeing him as an extension of itself. Juston's first major use of the Sentinel was to scare Greg and Josh, two bully-jocks who had been tormenting him and his friends. It worked, and Juston appeared to be a hero for scaring off the Sentinel. However, almost immediately after, Juston began to feel guilty for his ill-gotten fame. To redeem himself he began going out at night with the Sentinel to do some good including rescuing a truck driver from an accident and rescuing four survivors of a plane crash. Juston's Sentinel was eventually caught by the Commission on Superhuman Activities. Partially fearing being implicated and partially wanting to find his mother, Juston stole the Sentinel and ran away. right|300px|thumb|Juston fighting crime with his Sentinel Fearing that the reemergence of the Sentinel would lead to their convictions, Hunt and Knudesen decided to use a prototype Sentinel Mk VII-A to destroy the Sentinel and kill Juston. Juston was not able to find his mother, but he was able to escape Hunt's Stealth Sentinel, rescue his family, and blackmail Hunt and Knudsen into leaving them alone. After the their final battle, Juston used parts from the deactivated Sentinel Mk VII-A to repair and enhance his Sentinel. ===Avengers Academy=== After knowledge of Juston's Sentinel became public, everyone freaked out. To keep his Sentinel, Juston joined the Avengers Academy which had just expanded it's enrollment, and relocated to the Avengers Compound in Los Angeles, California. Despite his father's protest, Juston chose to remain with the Avengers Academy. left|150px|thumb|Pietro Maximoff (Earth-616)|Quicksilver and Giant-Man rebuilding Juston's Sentinel Juston continued to retool and modify his Sentinel, although it's presences at caused some issues with mutants at the Avengers Compound, and despite his best efforts, Juston was unable to remove the "Destroy All Mutants" programming. Juston was able to add new directives that contradicted this original programming and set the "Destroy All Mutants" program as it's least important directive. When the Phoenix Force imbued five X-Men with its cosmic powers, the Phoenix Five set out to reframe the world to their liking including the destruction of all Sentinels. Emma Frost personally came to the Avengers Compound to destroy Juston's Sentinel. Juston and the other students protested, and in the end Juston's Sentinel sacrificed itself to save Juston from Emma. Luckily, Quicksilver was able to obtain the Sentinel's central processing unit before Emma destroyed it, and the Sentinel was able to be rebuilt. right|200px|thumb|Juston working on his Sentinel right|200px|thumb|Juston's designed Sentinel as a battle robot armor ===Avengers Arena=== Juston and his Sentinel were among the sixteen young superheroes kidnapped by Arcade to battle to the death in his new Murderworld. To prevent suspicion, Arcade sent a humanoid robot to live with Juston's family in Antigo. Originally, Juston journeyed out with his classmates X-23, Hazmat, and Reptil. Unfortunately, it wasn't long before Juston and his Sentinel were attacked by Apex. During the struggle, Juston was paralyzed, the Sentinel was destroyed, and Juston was left for dead among the Sentinel wreckage in the desert. Fortunately, Juston survived, and driven by revenge he rebuilt the Sentinel as a pilot operated fighting machine. Bent on revenge, Juston tried to kill Apex, but was stopped by Tim Bashir. It wasn't long however until Apex regain control of her shared body, snapped Juston's neck, and left with his Sentinel, Death Locket, and Chasehawk. What remained of the Sentinel was finally destroyed by Nico with her Staff of One during her final battle with Apex. ===Legacy=== Despite its destruction, the Sentinel's inner system remained active and refused to let Juston perish. In form of improvised nanobots, the system entered Juston's body to resurrect him, transfo

sentinel prototype.name: Sentinel (Prototype)
sentinel prototype.origin: The Prototype Sentinel was developed by the Hellfire Club when they were operating in San Francisco at the beginning of the 20th century. They used psychics to learn more about the birth of the "Over-Men", the next stage in human development. They designed a weapon they dubbed the Sentinel to help track them down and destroy them if they got out of hand. left|thumb When the X-Club travelled back in time to collect DNA samples from Doctor Nemesis' parents, arrived they learned after their arrival that Dr. Nicola Bradley and his wife Catherine Price had been working on a new energy source. The Hellfire Club kidnapped them to use this energy source to power their new Sentinel. The X-Club came to their rescue but the battle between the Hellfire Club's Sentinel and the X-Club caused the 1906 San Francisco Earthquake.

sentinel 17.name: Sentinel 17
sentinel 17.origin: thumb|left|225px|Battling the X-Men (Earth-616)|X-Men ===Origin=== Sentinel 17 was one of the Sentinels Mk I created by Bolivar Trask to track down and eliminate the mutants, and one of the first Sentinels encountered by the X-Men, who didn't attack them but instead guided them into the Sentinels' fortress, as his programming wasn't complete for him to expect a friendly visit from mutants. As the mutants stopped following it after some time, it attacked them but was quickly countered by the mutants, and taken down by Jean Grey. thumb|left|225px|Rampaging in the streets of Iran ===Schism=== It was stored for years, and after the incident at the U.N. involving Quentin Quire, an Iranian leader presented a rusty Sentinel 17 as the creation of the greatest scientists of Iran and intended to unleash it to fight mutants, but first it wouldn't operate. Then, 17 activated and went wild in the streets, wounding, destroying, and killing indiscriminately. The X-Men intervened, Rogue destroying the Sentinel, and she and Kitty Pryde mocked the anti-mutant protesters and their leader for the situation's irony and for the fact that they felt insulted to be saved by women, with Pryde specifying that she was also Jewish as a final strike.

sentinel 221.name: Sentinel 221
sentinel 221.origin: Sentinel 221 was the first of the Sentinels who faced and attempted to eliminate the X-Men. Magneto, who was aware of the humans' intention to use the Sentinels to eliminate the mutants, lured the X-Men into a confrontation against his Brotherhood of Evil Mutants knowing that the Sentinels would step in to make them understand that the mutants had to react and be the ones to take power on humans if they didn't want to be exterminated.

sentinel mk ii.name: Sentinel MK II
sentinel mk ii.origin: The original Mk I Sentinels had been created by anti-mutant bigot Bolivar Trask, who came to understand that not all mutants were a threat to humanity and ultimately died to stop his own creations. However, Trask's son Larry, erroneously blamed the X-Men for his father's death, and decided to create new Sentinels to track and imprison the X-Men and other mutants. thumb|left|End of the Sentinels Mk II Thus, Larry developed more advanced Sentinels, some according to his own designs and some using his father's designs as a base (the 'leader' of the Mk II Sentinels, Number Two, was built from Bolivar's designs). Larry's main improvement was the addition of technology that allowed the Sentinels to physically adapt to any threat. Larry always wore a medallion that had been given to him by his father to cloak his own mutant powers, preventing his Mk II Sentinels from turning on him. Unfortunately, when the Sentinels eventually engaged the X-Men, the medallion fell from Larry's neck and the Sentinels discovered that he was a mutant. Deciding they would not obey a mutant, the Sentinels captured Larry, freeing themselves from his control. After the X-Men destroyed some of the Sentinels, the X-Man Cyclops convinced the Sentinels that they should seek out and destroy the main cause of human mutation instead of mutants themselves. Fooled by Cyclops' logic, Number Two took the surviving Sentinels directly to the main source of mutagenic radiation on Earth: the Sun. ===The Hidden Years=== The fragments of five Sentinels that were left behind in the base began to repair themselves into one unit. Randomly selecting a westward flight path It detected a mutant presence in Dunfee, Illinois that was revealed as ten-year old Ashley Martin. The Sentinel crashed and was too damaged to destroy her. Since Ashley had control over inorganic material, she was able to partially control the Sentinel and hid it in the house's barn, nicknaming the unit "Big Bot". However the arrival of Hank McCoy and Professor X triggered its programming. It attacked the pair but Ashley was able to overcome its programming temporarily. When it overrode her commands, she grew angry when it attacked, and forced Big Bot to destroy itself. ===The Avengers=== While orbiting the sun, Number Two computed that they lacked the firepower to destroy it and the Sentinels decided to approach the problem differently. They returned to Earth with a new goal: Try to provoke and control sun radiation, creating a sun-flare that would sterilize mankind, preventing the birth of new mutants (and humans). The Sentinels would then create a new species that could not mutate. However, the extended period spent in orbit of the sun actually caused mutations in Number Two, including the will to kill humans to reach their goals. On this occasion, the Avengers fought the Mk II Sentinels and destroyed them. Larry Trask also died in this operation when one of his depowered Sentinels collapsed on top of him, crushing him beneath its bulk. The Sentinels' lair was later invaded by Dr. Chalmers and her team, who accidently started their self-repair. The robots took an interest in experimenting with Gamma Radiation to help in their sterilization plan, an unit kidnapped the villain Abomination, the X-Men Rogue and Colossus were present when a robot attacked Doc Samson and were unable to prevent his kidnapping. the X-Men and Samson managed to defeat the robots. Chalmers was later revealed to be dying of cancer, she intended to build her own sentinels claiming It as means of being remembered and made a partnership with Abomination, they built a new unit of Sentinel out of parts from the destroyed MK II. Her attempt at using her own mind to initiate the robot backfired with the unit still intending to carry the sterilization plan It kidnapped Rogue, since her cells still possessed gamma information, the plan was foiled by the X-Men. It was revealed Chalmers actually wanted to pass on her mind to a Sentinel body but It had backfired, the Sentinel flew into the sun.

sentinel mk iii.name: Sentinel MK III
sentinel mk iii.origin: After the death of Lawrence Trask, the property of plans for the Sentinels fell to the government of the United States. Dr. Stephen Lang became the head of a federal research – Project: Armageddon – about mutants, trying to discover how mutations could provide superhuman powers. However, unbeknownst to his employers, Lang was an anti-mutant bigot who used his position to obtain access to the notes and designs of Larry Trask and Bolivar Trask, his father and creator of the original Mk I Sentinels. Lang also went to the Council of the Chosen Ones, part of the Hellfire Club, who provided him with funding to create new Sentinels and an orbital headquarters. The Council also ignored that Lang wanted to destroy every mutant he could capture as their leader, Ned Buckman, shared Lang's prejudices. After he used one of Lang’s Sentinels in an attack on fellow Council member Sebastian Shaw, an industrialist and secretly a mutant himself, a quiet civil war broke out where Buckman and his cohorts were murdered and replaced by Shaw’s mostly mutant Inner Circle. Surprise attacks upon the X-Men as they celebrated Christmas in Manhattan and upon Professor X while vacationing in the Bahamas led to their capture. Encased in “atmo-spheres”, the assembled mutants were taken to Project: Armageddon’s space station for analysis and eventual execution by Lang and his followers. left|thumb|250px|Wolverine discovers the true nature of the X-Sentinels The Mk III Sentinels were unfortunately inferior to the previous ones because Lang worked with only incomplete notes from the Trasks and because the secret of his activities stopped him from hiring enough experts. He also made them less intelligent than the previous Sentinels to stop any possible rebellion. Notably, Lang built Sentinels that looked like the original X-Men, which became known as the X-Sentinels. The X-Sentinels confused the newer X-Men to such a degree that they were ending up thrashed, but then Wolverine discovered that these impostors were not human and ripped up the Jean Grey lookalike, exposing their true nature. Lang's Sentinels and space station were destroyed in a battle between the Sentinels and the X-Men. Lang was lobotomized during the battle, but he had made a backup of his mind patterns that was used as a base for the mind of Master Mold and his other Sentinels. Unknown to the X-Men, another mutant, their old enemy The Vanisher, had also been captured by Lang and was being kept prisoner aboard the satellite. The damage caused by the battle and the X-Men's escape unleashed the Vanisher, who found semi-completed Sentinel robots which he managed to take control of them, Making plans to use them to attack his old enemies, the X-Men, he next recruited fellow mutant criminals The Blob, Lorelei, and Unus the Untouchable. Chased by a few of the Vanisher's Sentinels, the trio approached the Champions, seeking asylum from the apparently continued threat of Stephen Lang's Sentinels. Eventually taking the heroes captive, the villains dropped the ruse and the Vanisher explained that he intended to use them to draw out the X-Men, as to of the CHampions, Iceman and Angel, were former members. Darkstar then lashed out with the full potential of her powers, defeating the former Brotherhood members and apparently killing the Vanisher when her powers interfered with his attempt to teleport away. She also destroyed the Sentinels, apparently ending the last of the Mark III model.

sentinel mk iv.name: Sentinel MK IV
sentinel mk iv.origin: After the second Brotherhood of Evil Mutants tried to assassinate Senator Robert Kelly while he was performing a public research on the possible threat of superhuman beings and mutants, the President's Cabinet authorized secret and illegal Project Wideawake to research and, if needed, capture any superhuman mutant that the Project management could consider a threat to national security. The Project's head was Henry Gyrich, answering only to the President, with Senator Kelly himself as an special consultant.; The government contacted industrial tycoon Sebastian Shaw, ignoring that Shaw was a evil mutant himself, to build the new breed of Sentinels. Shaw Industries is authorized by the government to build top-secret Sentinels to be used in Project Awakening.; Shaw produced three models: Mark IV Sentinels, Mark V Sentinels and Mark VI Sentinels. None of these models proved to be as formidable as the Mark II and Mark III Sentinels. The models were constantly being modified and improved. Shaw secretly used Sentinels to attack his own enemies, the X-Men, but the government was unaware of this.

sentinel number 2.name: Sentinel Number 2
sentinel number 2.species: Mutant Sentinel Mk II; (Mutated by the Sun)
sentinel number 2.origin: Number Two was the commander of Larry Trask's Neo-Sentinels, following the orders left by his predecessor, Master Mold. When they were tricked by Cyclops to fly into the Sun and eliminate the source of all mutation, Number Two was mutated by close exposure to solar radiation, granting him full sentience and the power to teleport himself and others across vast distances. After returning from space, Number Two settled down in a hidden base in the Australian Outback. It then plotted to put a humane end to the mutant race by sterilizing humanity with a solar flare. WIth humanity eventually dying out, Number Two intended to work on creating a new version of the human race in the Sentinels' genetic labs; a version with no mutants among them. He thought it would be a permanent end to the "mutant menace," without actually having to kill anyone. Although it would take centuries for the Sentinels to perfect their genetic project, Number Two thought that his ilk would endure forever and they did not need to worry about deadlines. However, Number Two was destroyed by the other Sentinels when they discovered Number Two was a mutant as well. Number Two was rebuilt and revived by the Sentinels when they required his leadership. He again insisted on not killing human captives: "We do not slay humans unless they interfere with our anti-mutant directive." Dying from cancer, Cynthia Chalmers attempted to transfer her consciousness into Number Two's body. This left two personalities struggling for control of the body, with the Sentinel programming slowly merging with Cynthia's mentality. Unwilling to live as a human Sentinel, Cynthia forced their shared body into a suicide flight into the Sun.

Although it would take centuries for the Sentinels to perfect their genetic project, Number Two thought that his ilk would endure forever and they did not need to worry about deadlines. However, Number Two was destroyed by the other Sentinels when they discovered Number Two was a mutant as well. Number Two was rebuilt and revived by the Sentinels when they required his leadership. He again insisted on not killing human captives: "We do not slay humans unless they interfere with our anti-mutant directive." Dying from cancer, Cynthia Chalmers attempted to transfer her consciousness into Number Two's body. This left two personalities struggling for control of the body, with the Sentinel programming slowly merging with Cynthia's mentality. Unwilling to live as a human Sentinel, Cynthia forced their shared body into a suicide flight into the Sun.
powers: Same as those of the other Sentinels MK II. : Due to his systems being altered on a molecular level, Number Two has the mutant power to open teleportational gates.
fields.notes: Number Two thought that the Scarlet Witch was a much easier target for the Sentinels than Marvel Girl. He pointed out that the Avengers let the whole world know where they live, while the X-Men failed to inform the Sentinels about their current addresses.
fields.species: Mutant Sentinel Mk II; (Mutated by the Sun)

sentinel omega class.name: Sentinel Omega Class
sentinel omega class.origin: After the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants assassinated Senator Robert Kelly, anti-mutant hysteria grew and an extreme candidate was elected President. This President freed the Sentinels, giving them the open order to permanently eliminate the mutant "threat". The Sentinels reacted by taking control of the United States and all of North America, and killing or capturing virtually all of the super humans, be it mutants or not. Captured mutants were kept in concentration camps known as "mutant internment centers". The self-replicating Sentinels developed the new model, the Omega series, designed specially to hunt and kill super-human mutants. They share the most threatening feature of Mark II, a learning program. Later, the Omega Sentinels, absolute kings of the land, developed a more advanced Sentinel: Nimrod. The prototype of this project managed to go to Earth-616. thumb|left|The Sentinels at Battleworld A group of Sentinels were transported to a version of Battleworld created by Korvac of Earth-691. The Sentinels engaged a group of heroes and despite the machines' efforts to adapt against them, they were ultimately destroyed.

sentinel x.name: Sentinel X
sentinel x.species: Sentinel built by Forge to replace the Sentinel Squad O*N*E
sentinel x.origin: Because Forge was unsatisfied with the protection offered by the Sentinel Squad O*N*E, Forge began work on a new "Sentinel X" to protect mutantkind. Nimrod, being badly damaged, blackmailed Forge for repairs with threats of killing Storm. With the X-Men away on a mission, the New X-Men were the only ones available to hear and respond to Forge's distress signal. To delay Nimrod, Forge suggested he download himself into Sentinel X instead of repairing his old body. Once inside Sentinel X, Nimrod's programming was suppressed. Not realizing this, when the New X-Men arrived at Eagle Plaza in Dallas, Texas they damaged Sentinel X enough for Nimrod to override the programming and reformat his body. They were unable to defeat Nimrod until David and Forge figured out a way to stop him by overflowing his power core. Surge, Mercury, and X-23 accomplished this and managed to send Nimrod back in time.

sentry 213.name: Sentry 213
sentry 213.origin: The alien species known as the Kree developed and built the Sentries to watch over their military advanced bases and supply depots throughout all the Kree Empire and beyond. Some 80.000 years ago, in Kree year 1220, Kree scientist Bronek developed the prototype Sentry and the Supreme Council of the Kree Empire began to mass-build Sentries for military purposes. Hundreds of thousands of Sentries were built, although only a few thousands are currently active. Sentry 213 was the first Sentry sent to the Earth's system, and it was placed in a little surveillance/supply deport on the surface of Uranus. It was discovered by an exiled group of Eternals, who proceeded to destroy the Sentry and invade the depot. The Kree believed that the system lacked of intelligent life, so they sent an armada to investigate. They found the Eternals building a ship to go back to Earth. They fought and the Kree damaged the Eternal ship. The survivors had to refuge on Titan, a moon of Saturn, where they developed a technological civilization.

sentry 459.name: Sentry 459
sentry 459.origin: The alien species known as the Kree developed and built the Sentries to watch over their military advanced bases and supply depots throughout the Kree Empire and beyond. Some 80,000 years ago, in Kree year 1220, Kree scientist Bronek developed the prototype Sentry. The Supreme Council of the Kree Empire began to mass-build Sentries for military purposes. Hundreds of thousands of Sentries were built, although only a few thousand are currently active. Sentry 213 was the first Sentry sent to the Earth's system, and it was placed in a little surveillance/supply depot on the surface of Uranus. It was discovered by an exiled group of Eternals, who proceeded to destroy the Sentry and invade the depot. The second Sentry sent to the Earth system was Sentry 459, which escorted a team of Kree scientists wanting to research the most advanced life form of the system some 25,000 years ago. The Kree noticed that Earthlings could evolve to become advanced beings similar to the Eternals, so the Kree performed their own experiments, creating a genetically-advanced tribe that would become the Inhumans. The Kree hoped to one day use the Inhumans as an army so, when the scientists left, Sentry 459 was programmed to keep Inhumans under surveillance and monitor the progression of their civilization. Millenia after that, Inhuman geneticist Randac discovered the mutagenic Terrigen Mist that could genetically alter his kin. Sentry 459 activated for the first time and contacted its leaders. After which it returned to its hiding place and remained there for some millenia. During the mid-20th century, archaeologist Daniel Damian discovered the advanced subterranean base of Sentry 459 on a small island in the South Pacific. The Sentry re-activated due to the alarm system and again contacted its masters. One of the surveillance devices attracted the attention of the Fantastic Four, who were on vacation nearby. the Sentry fought them, but the Fantastic Four defeated the robot, freed Damian and his aide and escaped. The Sentry was later placed under custody of the United States government and taken to Cape Canaveral. Due to this defeat, the Kree sent their main agent Ronan the Accuser to Earth. A Kree Senior Field Grade Officer, Colonel Yon-Rogg, managed to get access to the Sentry and reactivated it. Yon-Rogg was the commander of a Kree reconnaissance mission on Earth, and also an enemy of one of his own Junior Field Grade Officers, Captain Mar-Vell. Yon-Rogg wanted the Sentry to fight and destroy Mar-Vell, but Mar-Vell defeated the Sentry. Ronan re-activated the Sentry after that, and used it in a scheme to invert the evolution in Earth. The scheme failed miserably and Ronan abandoned the Sentry on the Earth's North Pole. Kree agents Mac-Ronn and Tara found the Sentry and erased its previous programming and memories. They loaded the Sentry on their ship but, before they could escape with it, S.H.I.E.L.D. shot down their ship. The Sentry fell near Mexico City and went on a rampage, until stopped by Mar-Vell. The Sentry 459 was eventually destroyed by Ronan.
