shang chi.name: Shang-Chi
shang chi.species: Human;; Shang was raised to become a deadly assassin by his father, the immortal crimelord and sorcerer Zheng Zu.
shang chi.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|right|Master of Kung Fu Shang was raised to become a deadly assassin by his father, the immortal crime lord and sorcerer Fu Manchu. However, Shang-Chi became aware of his father's evil nature and defected after his first assignment. He then began to attack various elements of his father's criminal empire and allied himself with his father's archenemy, Denis Nayland Smith, and MI-6. In retaliation, Fu Manchu sent a number of assassins to kill him. His travels led him to meet a number of other martial artists and super heroes around the world: he met his rival, Cat; and teamed up with Iron Fist, Jack of Hearts, and White Tiger to take down the Corporation. After years of playing at "games of deceit and death", Shang-Chi retired from the espionage world. He resurfaced to assist his old friends from MI-6 against the Si-Fan ninjas. Over a decade later, his sister Fah Lo Suee, now called Cursed Lotus was once again involved in the criminal underworld. Fah Lo Suee headed a narcotics empire supplying the highly addictive drug, Wild Tiger. Representing her in Hong Kong was the Wild Tiger Mob led by Deng Ling-Xiao. It was brought down by Shang-Chi who never learned that she was behind it all. Shang-Chi faced the Si-Fan again, now under the command of Kingpin, with help from the X-Men against Cyber-Ninjas and from Elektra against other ninjas. ===Marvel Knights=== When Daredevil wanted a task force to help him finally capture the Punisher and make him face legal justice, Shang-Chi became a part of that group. The martial artist assisted Daredevil, Black Widow, and their allies against the Punisher and several other threats before the group went their separate ways. During this period, Shang-Chi and the Marvel Knights faced Zaran (Zhou Man She) and Dacoits in Fu Manchu's service. ===Hellfire Apocalypse=== Fu Manchu later built the Hellfire Weapon which could destroy cities, before being foiled once again by Shang-Chi and MI6. During this period, his father used the name Comte de Saint Germain. ===Black Panther=== As the Black Panther was touring in the United States, looking for a wife, Fu Manchu had him followed by his ninjas to Luke Cage's flat. The ninjas attacked the two heroes but were forced to retreat, allowing the pair to infiltrate their ship and then Zheng Zu's Mountain Base. Going now by the name of "Han", Fu Manchu offered his daughter Kwai Far to T'Challa, hoping to unite their kingdoms. But as the Panther refused the offer, feeling he was at that point bound to Storm, Han got mad, rejecting his daughter and unleashing his ninjas over the two heroes, soon rejoined by his son Shang-Chi. Cage, T'Challa, and Shang-Shi managed to defeat the ninjas and dodge the Dragon, and all left the fortress along with Kwai Far. ===Heroes for Hire=== When the Superhuman Registration Act was signed into law, Shang-Chi joined Misty Knight and Colleen Wing as part of their Heroes for Hire, a team of investigators and superhuman bail bondsmen. During this time, he developed romantic feelings for his teammate Tarantula, but her overly violent nature shamed him, and he lost his center. During the Hulk's invasion of Manhattan, their teammate Humbug killed one of the insect-like hatchlings as they infiltrated the hive. Humbug was then seduced into an insect hive-mind with No-Name of the Brood. When the hive tried to identify the hatchling's killer, Humbug gave the hive Tarantula's name instead. Shang-Chi infiltrated the hive with the intent to rescue Humbug and hopefully sever his link to the newborn hive. After hearing of Humbug's betrayal of Tarantula, however, Shang-Chi lost his temper and killed Humbug. Grieving over how completely he had lost his way, Shang-Chi left the Heroes for Hire to meditate and renew his connection to his spirit. ===Secret Avengers=== Shang-Chi's illustrious father returned to the world with the assistance of his Celestial Order of Hai-Dai and the Shadow Council. Shang teamed up with Steve Rogers and his Secret Avengers to oppose his father. After that, he became an important ally for Steve's unit, aiding the team whenever needed. ===Fear Itself=== In Washington D.C., Shand-Chi joined other heroes in an effort to confront Skadi. During the confrontation, Bucky Barnes, as Captain America, was seriously injured by Skadi, who ripped off his bionic arm and pierced his chest with her hammer, leaving him on the verge of death. With his dying breath, Bucky instructed his fellow heroes to warn others of the Serpent's imminent arrival. ===Fearless Defenders=== After Zheng Zu's death, Zheng Bao Yu (his sister's real name, formerly known as Fah Lo Suee and Cursed Lotus) and Hai-Dai set up a lab under Chinatown, in New York City, where they continued a long-forgotten experiment of Zheng Zu by bio-engineering Brood (or rather "genetic mutations spawned from tainted Brood DNA"), which they used for assassinations, until the Defenders Valkyrie and Misty Knight recruited Elsa Bloodstone in their

fields.personality: Originally portrayed as a stoic and emotionally detached martial artist, Shang-Chi gradually developed into a more relatable and personable hero while retaining his discipline, humility, and commitment to inner peace. Although devoted to meditation and self-improvement, he has always sought a simple, ordinary life free from violence. Throughout much of his career, however, Shang-Chi repeatedly found himself drawn back into the "games of death and deceit" surrounding his father's criminal empire, despite his constant efforts to escape them. Even after forging a new life in San Francisco, he continued to struggle with balancing domestic normalcy against the responsibilities of his family legacy. During his years working alongside MI-6 and later Freelance Restorations, Shang-Chi often questioned whether he was truly serving justice or merely being used as a weapon against his father. Although he formed close friendships with many of his allies, he occasionally endured prejudice and racial stereotyping from some of them. Rather than remaining silent, Shang-Chi openly challenged such attitudes, refusing to allow either his heritage or his father's reputation to define him. After assuming leadership of the Five Weapons Society following the fall of Zheng Zu, Shang-Chi dedicated himself to reforming the organization into a force for good. While he accepted the role out of duty rather than ambition, he frequently felt caught between two worlds, viewed with suspicion by fellow superheroes because of his position while simultaneously facing skepticism from members of the Society who questioned his compassionate leadership. Despite his calm demeanor, Shang-Chi possesses a dry, self-aware sense of humor and often comments on the absurdity of his circumstances. He has admitted to deliberately adopting a slower, proverb-like manner of speaking around Westerners, recognizing that it causes people to pay closer attention to his words. Beneath his confidence, Shang-Chi carries an immense sense of responsibility toward his family, sometimes keeping secrets from his allies or making idealistic decisions to protect his siblings, even at his own expense. His greatest fear is becoming like his father, and moments in which he has been corrupted by dark influences have only strengthened his resolve to define himself by his own choices rather than his bloodline. Shang-Chi's relationships with his siblings further illustrate his role as both their leader and moral compass. While each possesses contrasting personalities and philosophies, he consistently strives to guide them toward redemption rather than domination. Esme's sarcastic wit and willingness to employ lethal force frequently clash with Shang-Chi's pacifism, whereas Takeshi enthusiastically supports his leadership despite his impulsive nature. Although Shi-Hua initially resented Shang-Chi and sought to surpass him, she ultimately abandoned her vendetta after recognizing his genuine devotion to their family. Zhilan, whose quiet integrity and desire for peace closely mirror Shang-Chi's own ideals, became one of his closest allies after realizing they shared the same commitment to justice over power.

fields.trivia: Although Shang-Chi was a uniquely Marvel Comics creation, many of his supporting cast members including Fu Manchu, Fah Lo Suee, and Sir Denis Nayland Smith were actually the creation of early 20th century novelist . Fu Manchu and Denis Nayland Smith made their literary debuts in the 1916 novel The Insidious Dr. Fu Manchu. In 1995, Marvel Comics almost outsourced the production of a line of four interconnected series to Milestone Media. Shang-Chi was going to star one of these books. The pitch of the story, written by Dwayne McDuffie, consisted of Shang-Chi traveling around the globe to dismantle his father's criminal empire and also adding firearms to his combat repertoire. The entire project fell apart since McDuffie had arranged it with Tom DeFalco and Mark Gruenwald. DeFalco would be soon replaced as Editor-in-Chief, and Gruenwald would pass away a year later. Shang-ChiBuddhist identifies himself as a 'bodhisattva', a 'person who is on the path towards Buddhahood but has not yet attained it.' The name Shang-Chi was created by Steve Englehart, through his study of the I-Ching, combining the characters 升 (shēng, “to ascend”) and 氣 (qì, “vital energy”), meaning “the rising and advancing of the spirit.” In 2019, actor Ronny Chieng (featured in Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings) advised against using the translation 上氣 (shàng qì), which in modern Chinese means something like “upper air” — an odd fit for a superhero. Chieng suggested 神奇 (shén qí, “magical” or “wonderful”) as a more culturally appropriate alternative. To preserve Englehart's original intent, the most accurate translation would be 昇華的靈氣 (shēnghuá de língqì). In (October 2025), Shen Qi was used as the name for the Earth-6160 variant.

shang ti.name: Shang-Ti
shang ti.origin: Shang-Ti is a member of the Xian pantheon of gods, he is worshiped by some Chinese religions as the god of goodness. He supports causes that are seen as good, and destroys those carrying out evil. His origins and histories are unknown. With the outbreak of the Korean War in the 1950s, a commanding officer in the People's Liberation Army convinced his troops to be loyal to the Communist occupation of Korea by having some of his men pose in a giant mock up of Shang-Ti. This effigy was encountered by American troops Battle Brady and Socko Swenski. They exposed the effigy as a hoax, but were captured and the secret covered up to insure continued loyalty of the Chinese soldiers. However, before Battle Brady and Socko Swenski could be executed the real Shang-Ti arrived and began slaughtering the Chinese troops, either not agreeing with the invasion of South Korea or in anger at the Chinese army for using his image. Eventually the Chinese soldiers who survived surrendered and bowed down to Shang-Ti. He supports causes that are seen as good, and destroys those carrying out evil. His origins and histories are unknown. With the outbreak of the Korean War in the 1950s, a commanding officer in the People's Liberation Army convinced his troops to be loyal to the Communist occupation of Korea by having some of his men pose in a giant mock up of Shang-Ti. This effigy was encountered by American troops Battle Brady and Socko Swenski. They exposed the effigy as a hoax, but were captured and the secret covered up to insure continued loyalty of the Chinese soldiers. However, before Battle Brady and Socko Swenski could be executed the real Shang-Ti arrived and began slaughtering the Chinese troops, either not agreeing with the invasion of South Korea or in anger at the Chinese army for using his image. Eventually the Chinese soldiers who survived surrendered and bowed down to Shang-Ti. Shang-Ti then vanished as suddenly as he appeared, leaving Battle and Socko to wonder if what they witnessed really happened. Shang-Ti has not been seen since, his present activities are unknown.

shann.name: Shann
shann.origin: Shann was the ruler of a distant planet. The people of Shann's planet were content, and Shann was worried that this will mean that they will take him for granted and not be awed by his presence. He soon comes up with a solution to become exalted by his people again: invade another planet. He preps his people to go to war against the planet Andromia, and has his people build weapons of war and space ships to attack the people. They find the people of Andromia are peaceful farmer folk, and are easily defeated. Shann has his troops destroy their cities and farm lands in the name of conquest until the people of Andromia surrender. Shortly after their conquest of the planet, Shann is praised as a hero, but soon comes to realize that his decimation of Andromia's means of being self sufficiency has forced him to provide to them, so that they do not starve. Soon the people of Shann's planet begin having to work to sustain the people of Andromia, as well. Eventually, the people of Shann's home world grow to hate him for lowering their quality of life. Soon, Shann realizes his own vanity has cost him the respect of his people.

shanna red slayer.name: Shanna (Red Slayer)
shanna red slayer.origin: Shanna was a member of King Kull's Red Slayers, a group the finest warriors of Valusia. Shanna and a group of Slayers accompanied Kull and Brule on their journey to find the fabled temple of the Serpent-Men. While attempting to reach the temple, by crossing a large river on a raft, the group was attacked by a large sea dragon summoned by Serpent-Men priests. The creature destroyed the raft, and sent the group, including Shanna, into the water. While the group was thrashed about the river by the monster, Kull and Brule drove the monster off with their weapons. After surfacing, Kull pulled Shanna's lifeless body to the shore, but was unable to revive him.

shannon fitzpatrick.name: Shannon Fitzpatrick
shannon fitzpatrick.origin: Muse was James Johnsmeyer's greatest player in the Great Game, a series of staged fights between superhumans. At some point she faced off against Quorum, another of Johnsmeyer's players. Muse and Mosh followed Detective Jacob Raven to the warehouse where Kaine's body had been moved and stole it, bringing it back to Johnsmeyer's estate, where he was nursed back to health. Muse greeted the newly-revived Kaine as he defeated Quorum, Mosh, and several other thugs. After giving Johnsmeyer a progress report, she attended to Kaine, explaining his resurrection. She introduced him to Johnsmeyer, but Kaine refused his offer to play in the Great Game and left. While leaving the Johnsmeyer estate, Quorum and Mosh confronted him, but Muse knocked Quorum out and mesmerized Mosh to put his gun down, allowing Kaine to defeat him. She asked Kaine to take her with him. As Muse and Kaine escaped through a New York City alleyway, they were confronted by the Rhino, who had joined the Great Game. As the Rhino tried to goad Kaine into a fight, Spider-Man intervened, rescuing Muse from a toppled wall only to be buried in rubble himself. In the confusion, Muse and Kaine escaped.

fields.notes: Shannon rekindled memories of Louise Kennedy in Kaine, the first love of his life who had eventually betrayed him. Kaine grabbed Shannon by the throat and attempted to strangulate her, despite his attraction to her. Yet, Shannon still attacked Spider-Man in order to protect Kaine. She seems to genuinely care for her short-term partner Kaine, though it is unclear if she is romantically interested in him. It is unclear how Shannon gained her powers, but she was considered a likely mutant by the writers of the Appendix to the Marvel Handbook. She has explicitly mentioned that she has restrained the use of her blasts during her encounters with Kaine and Ben Reilly, and she went against orders to not harm them. Her blasts are strong enough to blast holes in walls, but she seems hesitant to use them in a lethal way.
fields.trivia: In her few appearances, she was depicted at times with light brown hair, and at times with red hair. Her energy blasts seem to have the same purple shade as her uniform.

shannon kane.name: Shannon Kane
shannon kane.origin: Shannon Kane's husband created a "spider web fluid" similar to that used by Spider-Man. Unfortunately, he was murdered by Communists, leading Shannon Kane to become the Spider Queen and use his web fluid against criminals. She became the "sworn enemy of saboteurs, racketeers, gangsters -- criminals of every sort." With her web fluid, she could stick people to walls and the ground and swing from buildings; she designed web bracelets that functioned like Spider-Man's web-shooters. She apparently also had affairs with Krupp and Speer, giving her access to experimental technology. Though she originally envisioned herself as an enemy to evildoers everywhere, Shannon Kane joined the Battle-Axis because she believed that only the Axis powers could eliminate the threat of Communism. She aided the team in "Project Mojave", a plan to use a device called the oscillotron to create an earthquake that would destroy war industry plants and release poison gas, thereby theoretically crippling America's ability to fight the war. The team first battled with the Invaders in June 1942 while defending a Nazi U-Boat. Later, accompanied by Silver Scorpion and the Blazing Skull, the Invaders attacked them again when Battle-Axis attempted to travel to Hollywood to kidnap Dr. Johann Goldstein in order to extort his brother Golem into aiding them. Though Battle-Axis managed to force Vision to intercept the Invaders by threatening to cut him off from his home dimension, the Invaders tricked Axis member Volton into releasing Captain America, who then freed the other Invaders. The ensuing battle led to the death of Dr. Goldstein and the destruction of the Battle-Axis base. Afterwards, the members of Battle-Axis were taken into custody. After the war, she established herself as a killer for hire. She was recruited into ICON by Geoffrey Sydenham in the late 1950s and was captured by the Avengers in Washington, D.C. after she was knocked unconscious by the Blonde Phantom. Spider Queen's current status and whereabouts remain unrevealed, although her costume appeared on a dummy in the mansion of the Angel in the modern day.

shannon sugarbaker.name: Shannon Sugarbaker
shannon sugarbaker.origin: According to herself, Shannon Sugarbaker has had three passions in her life: Her ex-boyfriend Claude, cosplaying using functional ersatz weaponry, and hunting. In order to fulfill her last hobby, she used her vast fortune to buy knockoff Doombots which she attempted to reprogram and use as prey. Her plan failed, so she resorted to the closest legally available option after humans: anthropomorphic animals. Having hired the services of Kraven the Hunter, Shannon captured several of these animals, or any subject she deemed to be so. Her victims were Rocket Raccoon, Beast, her ex-boyfriend's cat Biggs, Weapon II, and Howard the Duck. Super hero Squirrel Girl was present on the scene when Kraven captured Howard, and followed him to Sugarbaker's mansion. After defeating Squirrel Girl with her knock-off weapons, Sugarbaker placed her in an arena with the other captives, including Kraven, after a disagreement with Shannon. Sugarbaker managed to knock out most of her preys, who were taken back to the mansion so they could be hunted again later. Howard the Duck and Squirrel Girl managed to find one of the secret tunnels used to bring back the prisoners to the mansion and infiltrated the building. With the disappearance of these two contestants, Sugarbaker threatened to start killing the others. Outfitted with some of Sugarbaker's knock-off weaponry, Howard confronted her, buying Squirrel Girl enough time to free the other prisoners. With the help of the others, Squirrel Girl and Howard eventually managed to defeat Sugarbaker. Her house was burnt down in the process, but everyone got out alive.

shanzar.name: Shanzar
shanzar.origin: Shanzar had declared himself the Sorcerer Supreme of his dimension, the "Strange Universe". As he destroyed or assimilated everyone in his world, he sought new worlds for conquest and adventure. To enter Earth-616 (or apparently any other dimension), he required a strong host body. He acquired one when he took over the body of the Hulk which transformed him into the Dark Hulk. Shanzar entered worlds through mystic portals and grabbed his prey with large expanding tentacles. He then took mystic command of this "host" and could safely enter other dimensions. When separated from his host, he appears as a spirit form. Bruce Banner's psyche, along with Doctor Strange and the Sub-Mariner, were able to defeat Shanzar and return him to his dimension.

shaper of worlds.name: Shaper of Worlds
shaper of worlds.species: Sentient Cosmic Cube with Robotic features; Cosmic Being
shaper of worlds.origin: ===Origins=== Thousands of years ago, the Skrulls developed an artifact to modify reality following the wishes of the user. It was the Cosmic Cube, apparently created by forming a meta-singularity or gray hole. It was really an opening to a dimension containing sentient energy created by the mysterious Beyonders, who wish to improve the development of sentient life. An X-Element from that universe crossed the grey hole and was trapped in a perfect force cube created by Skrull scientists. The Skrull emperor took the cube and declared himself a god. He reigned for many years but, unbeknownst to all, the Cube had potential to become a sentient being itself. thumb|left|The Shaper of Worlds' origins as the Skrull Cosmic Cube Through the years of use, the emperor involuntarily imprinted some of his own traits upon the embryonic consciousness of the Cube, and thus the Cube began to develop his own personality. Since the Skrull emperor was a megalomaniac madman, the Cube mimicked that attribute. The Cube, acting on its own, transformed and destroyed several star systems in the Skrull's Andromeda Galaxy. Upon reaching emotional maturity, it had destroyed civilizations in two-thirds of the inhabited worlds in the galaxy, and as a result the Skrull Empire succumbed to barbarism, though the Skrulls would eventually reconstruct their empire centuries later. The Cube ultimately transcended the emperor's madness and developed its own masculine personality. It changed its body to look like a Skrull from the waist upwards. Motivated by its powers, he adopted the name of the Shaper of Worlds. Apparently due to a similar fault in the emperor, the Shaper had a very limited creative imagination, so he looked for intelligent beings whose imaginations would give him patterns to shape the worlds. The Shaper traveled through worlds giving substance to the imagination of "lesser beings". He traveled to Earth many times, attracted by the potential of the native humans. ===Creating in the Microverse=== The Shaper created a replica of Earth in the Microverse. On this alternate Earth the Nazis had invaded the United States of America. The Hulk arrived on the world when he was shrinking through the Microverse. Battling the Nazis, the Hulk learned the truth about the Shaper. The Hulk confronted him and told him that he would deal with him once the fantasy was over. Hulk then teamed up with the alternate United States Army and turned the tides of the war. He found Dr. Otto Kronsteig, a former Nazi scientist who was banished to the Microverse by Doctor Doom, and was currently the subject whom the Shaper was shaping fantasies from. When Otto began to doubt the Shaper's promises, the Shaper appeared to him and reminded Otto that while he had the power to turn fantasy into reality, he was devoid of imagination, and as such sought out other beings to make their fantasies manifest, and that the only way the Hulk could win this battle was through Otto's doubting mind. Otto then became Captain Axis, but the Hulk's power was too much, and he once again began to doubt himself. The Shaper came to the Hulk, furious at him for having ruined the illusion, and decided to manifest the Hulk's fantasies into reality instead; however, when the Shaper created illusions of his friends on Earth, as well as the late Jarella, the Hulk lashed out, knowing that they were not the real thing, and renouncing the gifts the Shaper had offered. Unable to appease the stubborn Hulk, the Shaper of Worlds sent him back on his way, resuming his reduction in size. Having become exhausted after this most recent bout, the Shaper decided to leave his microworld creation, and all its inhabitants behind, to reflect on everything that he has encountered. ===Taking an Apprentice=== thumb|right|Creating Glorian The Shaper next decided that he could not live forever and, understanding the latent psionic potential of Earthlings, took one of them as his apprentice: Thomas Gideon, now known as Glorian. The Shaper, having realized that he lacked imagination to create his own illusions, had decided to bring joy to others, and thus experience their wildest imaginations vicariously through them. He selected the Hulk as the first such person to receive his gift and sent Glorian, who thanked the Shaper for saving his life and giving him new purpose, to find him. The Hulk's wishes were granted, and he was reunited with old friends, but cracks soon began to appear, and the Hulk realized that this was all a lie once again; however, the Toad Men happened upon the Hulk's fantasy world, and wanting a world of their own, hoped to use the Shaper's powers to their own ends. thumb|left|With Glorian The Hulk was forced by the Toad Men to find the Shaper and confront him, but the Shaper was insulted that the Hulk would turn away his gift and attempt to attack him. When the Shaper realized that the Hulk had a Nullatron Bomb strapped to his back, he reacted too late to stop it from detonating, and the blast

shapur.name: Shapur
shapur.origin: Shapur was the ruthless warlord of El Shah Maddoc when Conan arrived and, in short order, stole the Kothian's job. Like the Cimmerian, he was sent by King Maddoc II with untrained troops (prisoners released from the cells) to battle the savage M'Gai tribe. Shapur recovered the magical amulet which was stolen by Kollos and brought him back to Conan, eventually pledging allegiance to the Cimmerian. When they returned to the city with Imhotep, Shapur helped the Cimmerian assaulting Maddoc's castle. Shapur then enlisted Kaleb and Simeon to help Conan secure Jahli's future as the legitimate heir to the throne of the El Shah Maddoc. When his grandson was murdered, Shapur disobeyed Conan's orders and helped him fight off Ybn's entire army of assassins. Shapur joined Conan in his military service on behalf of rebel Prince Irham. Shapur persuaded in vain General Freja to recognize Conan's authority and obey his orders. A short time later, the Cimmerian won Shapur friendship's and loyalty. Conan told him to clap General Freja in chains, but he couldn't, since his men got him first. When Red Sonja was found unconscious, badly beaten, and sexually assaulted in the Kothian wilderness, Shapur blamed himself for treating her as any other soldier. As Conan told his comrades he wanted to challenge Bahkt, who was responsible for Sonja's assault, Shapur at first warned the Cimmerian of his demonic power, but then wished him good luck. When Kaleb decked Conan for grabbing Solaise, Shapur told Kobe to stop them, but he refused, since it would interfere with a matter of honor. As the Cimmerian and the Aesir then disappeared into a portal in the air, Shapur and his band traveled to the Forest of the Eternal Verities, when, all of a sudden, he witnessed Simeon being struck by a lightning, and the Staff of the Elder Gods turning into a sword. When the Cimmerian's small army was about to move on, Shapur asked Kobe to remain with Sonja and keen an eye on her, but he refused and was replaced by Simeon. When Conan bargained with Thulsa Doom to fight against the Devourer of Souls, Shapur feared it would cost them their souls.

shara.name: Shara
shara.origin: Born in the small South African country Kwarrai, Shara was the daughter of a respected scientist. She was accidentally exposed to radioactive Vibranium in her father's laboratory, after which she suffered poisoning that weakened her body, leaving her in a wheelchair. With her days numbered unless a cure could be found, Shara was sent to Hammond Labs Facility in Springdale, Connecticut, where she underwent experimental and painful treatments led by Dr. Nicholas Benson. She noticed Robbie Baldwin, a lab assistant the same age as her, asked who he was, and was looking for a way to meet him, ignoring that Baldwin had done the same regarding her. After seeking advice from her parents (who encouraged him to meet Shara, but prepared him for the inevitable tragedy), Baldwin decided to bump into her to introduce himself, and they both found the situation awkward but fun. Baldwin immediately offered to help Shara, and the first thing she asked for was to sit on the grass again to watch the sunset. Over the next few weeks, when she was not undergoing experiments, Baldwin took her on picnics and to her first, and last, football game. Dr. Benson however was pessimistic and had decided that, if they did not find a cure for her soon, they would send her back to Kwarrai so that she could spend her last days in the company of her family. The day before she was to travel, Baldwin revealed to Shara that he had superpowers and used the secret identity Speedball, so that that secret would not remain between them when she left. Shara responded by kissing Baldwin/Speedball. But that same night, there was an unexpected earthquake in Kwarrai that killed Shara's family and wrecked the whole country. The emotional shock activated Shara's superhuman powers that allowed her to stand and launch attacks that destroyed solid rock. Shara broke the outer wall of her room and fled Hammond Labs, injuring Benson. Out of control and upset, but not wanting to harm anyone, she looked for a quarry to destroy in a cathartic display of aggression; however, Shara did not notice some children playing there, whom she was putting in danger. Baldwin, upon discovering all this, went to look for Shara, and tried to stop her: First he shouted at her, but the noise she caused prevented her from hearing him. Baldwin then attempted to use his own powers, but Shara's powers nullified Speedball's. Still, putting himself in danger, Baldwin attempted to protect the children. His actions caused Shara to see the children and understand what had happened. She then used her own powers to stop the rocks from falling on the innocents as they escaped, but she could not prevent herself from being buried. As Shara was dying, Baldwin regained her powers and quickly went to dig Shara up, but only had her die in her arms, saying that she loved Baldwin. Press and TV news about this event renamed Shara Vibrania, although she had never used this nickname.

sharada darthri.name: Sharada Darthri
sharada darthri.origin: Sharada Darthri is an eminent geneticist, working for the Providian Order. To achieve their goals she experimented on various races, combing their genes. At some point, after the death of Emperor Vulcan, his wife was captured by the Order. However, they weren't interested in Deathbird, but in her child - a hybrid of atavistic Shi'ar and powerful Mutant. Sharada Darthri experimented on the baby and attempted to infuse it with Kree genes.

sharalla.name: Sharalla
sharalla.origin: Sharalla was a beautiful girl from an alien dimension and was the priestess of the demon Tryphon. She had the human adventurer Simon Majors captured and sacrificed to Tryphon twice, but she was attracted to him. When Tryphon was about to attack Simon during the sacrifice, the energy with which Simon was sprinkled proved lethal for Tryphon who accused Sharalla of betraying him and attacked her but Simon ran to her rescue destroying Tryphon, then took Sharalla with him on Earth but as soon as she crossed the portal Sharalla disintegrated into a mass of dust leaving Simon, who by now loved her, desperate for having lost her.

shari sebbens.name: Shari Sebbens
shari sebbens.origin: Shari Sebbens was a detective with the NYPD. After Spider-Man rescued her husband and daughter, she collaborated with him on a few occasions, even when her superiors at the 5th Precinct Station House were against it. Some time later, she worked with Forensic Scientist Carlie Cooper to investigate the mysterious dead body found in one of Miles Warren's secret labs. During her investigation, she teamed up with Sha Shan Nguyen, who was searching for her missing friends from the Coffee Bean and was suspicious of her college Raymond Warren--Miles' brother--due to his recent change in behavior. Believing Raymond was a clone created by Miles, they tracked him down to the Arcadium and discovered that Sha Shan's friends had been taken there. They helped the two Spider-Men subdue the Jackal and his clones, and Sebbens arrested and unmasked Jackal, revealing himself to be Raymond. However, Sebbens deduced that "Raymond" was in fact Miles, who had murdered and impersonated his older brother. After Miles was taken away by the police, Sebbens and Nguyen helped escort the Arcadium's victims back to the Coffee Bean.

sharilla.name: Sharilla
sharilla.origin: Sharilla was the K'rithian security-master. After teleporting Dr. Giles Niven along with the Thing and Franklin Richards, he told Niven that it was his people who had influenced Niven to create the "Space Saver" video game and tested it and deemed him to be the greatest of the Space Savers and have asked for him to assist in stopping the massive Gh'runjians before they consume their world. Together with the Thing and Franklin they helped the K'rithians defeat the Gh'runjians, and at the end Sharilla offered Niven to stay on K'rith and be celebrated as a hero, an offer that Niven agrees to.

shark.name: Shark
shark.origin: Verill Shark was a notorious pirate during the 1940s. In 1942 he aligned himself with the Nazis during World War II and joined Agent Axis and the Hyena on a mission to destroy Invader members Captain America, Sub-Mariner, and Human Torch and collect trophies from each. The Shark targeted the Sub-Mariner and with his crew incapacitated the hero and stole his swim trunks which he mockingly used as a flag for his vessel. Before he could eliminate Namor, the hero was plucked from time by the Grandmaster along with Cap and the Torch to battle the time displaced Avengers. Following the end of the battle, the Sub-Mariner was returned to his proper place in time and easily defeated the Shark and reclaimed his trunks. Avoiding capture during the war and resuming his pirate activities, the Shark resurfaced again in 1947. This time he targeted "Deep Sea Dan" Barrow's salvage operation of the Marta Carta, a Spanish vessel that sank carrying a cargo of gold bullion. To this end, he sent his men to kidnap Dan's daughter Shiela, but the kidnapping was botched when the Sub-Mariner rescued the girl and brought him back to his private yacht. However, after Namor left to keep an eye on the salvage operation, the Shark's men recaptured Shiela but were unknowingly followed by Namor's reporter friend Betty Dean. The Shark then sent a decoy ship loaded with explosives to go off near Dan's ship, killing the divers below salvaging the gold and incapacitating the ship. Namor ultimately stopped the Shark's divers from stealing the gold and easily bested the Shark in battle. However, one of the Shark's men attempted to kill Namor and his allies with explosives, but succeeded only in destroying the ship and sending them all unharmed into the water. The Shark was recovered and turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

sharkosh.name: Sharkosh
sharkosh.origin: Sharkosh was an aged Vanir shaman who whisked away Tara from her universe within the Star-Stone, and transformed her into an earthly handmaid. In order to let her remain in this world, Sharkosh allied with Volff the Wily's Vanirmen to sacrifice Conan so he would take her place in her own reality. Before completing the ceremony of transferal, Sharkosh however turned mad because of the futuristic visions projected by the Star-Stone, and was eventually killed by an explosion of supernatural energy.

sharkskin.name: Sharkskin
sharkskin.origin: Sharkskin was one of three mutant Atlanteans who made up the team known as SURF. During the Atlantis Attacks conflict he and his teammates protected Namorita when she was attacked by Lord Ghaur's forces as they attempted to steal the Horn of Proteus. Later, Sharkskin and the rest of SURF broke into Marine World to free captive whales, but they were stopped by the West Coast Avengers. Sharkskin and SURF took up residence in the underwater Graymalkin and defended it when it was breached by Cable and Major X.

sharn.name: Sharn
sharn.origin: Elder Sharn was the leader of her tribe, the Desert Sea Clan, who were allies of Headman Bahng's Doka'abi Clan. After her husband failed to complete the Warlord's barbaric trial known as the Gauntlet, their clan was absorbed into the Warlord's army. In remembrance of the Desert Sea Clan's alliance with the Doka'abi, Sharn visited their settlement with her two sons and gifted them seven charged fuel cells. Unfortunately, their actions were witnessed by Lickspit. When the Doka'abi Clan's champion, the Hulk, faced the Gauntlet's second trial, his enemy had Elder Sharn and her two sons fastened to his shield.

sharon wolfpack.name: Sharon (Wolfpack)
sharon wolfpack.origin: Daughter of a Vietnamese woman and an American father, Sharon was an honor high school student, she was on the track team and she even had an after-school job at the local Burger Clown. Due to all these amazing qualities, Mr. Mack began to train her. When the time came, Mr. Mack gathered all his pupils and formed the Wolfpack to battle the The Nine and their forces in South Bronx, in New York. None of the members had experience in team work, but after the death of Mr. Mack and the imprisonment of Samuel Weltschmerz (one of their teammates and Mr. Mack's oldest student), they got together and won their first victory against the The Nine.

sharon banks.name: Sharon Banks
sharon banks.origin: Sharon Banks was the defense attorney who represented Flash Thompson when he was framed by Roderick Kingsley and arrested for the crimes of the super-villain the Hobgoblin (when Kingsley was actually the Hobgoblin). Sharon arranged for Flash's friend Peter Parker to interview Flash in custody, unaware that Parker was secretly the super-hero and enemy of the Hobgoblin, Spider-Man. Sharon was meeting with her client in custody when the mercenary Jack O'Lantern, seeking to make a name for himself with New York's crimelords, broke into Flash's cell to spring him. Sharon pleaded with Flash not to go with him, knowing how it would look, and was struck by Jack O'Lantern. When Flash came to her defense, Jack O'Lantern knocked him out and escaped with him. Sharon was later present when Flash was cleared of all charges by District Attorney Blake Tower.

sharon carter.name: Sharon Carter
sharon carter.origin: ===Early Life=== Sharon Carter is the daughter of Harrison and Amanda Carter, two wealthy Virginians, and the niece of Margaret "Peggy" Carter, a heroic freedom fighter during World War II, who had shared many adventures with the great hero Captain America before his supposed death at the end of the war. When Peggy returned home in need of hospitalization from traumatic shell-shock, she told her niece many stories about Captain America. ===S.H.I.E.L.D.=== Inspired by these tales and her own aunt's exploits, Sharon decided to become an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., the international espionage agency. On her first major assignment, Sharon Carter, code-named Agent 13, was chosen to pick up a cylinder containing the powerful explosive called Inferno-42 from a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who had stolen it from THEM, the governing body of the subversive organization Hydra. By coincidence, Captain America, in his secret identity of Steve Rogers, saw Carter on her way to receive the cylinder and was struck by her close resemblance to her aunt Peggy. However, Rogers had no idea who Sharon Carter was, having known Peggy only by her cover identity. sharon davis.name: Sharon Davis
sharon davis.origin: Sharon Davis was a Westview citizen. Following Wanda Maximoff's transformation of Westview into a sitcom reality, she was cast as Mrs. Hart, while her husband Todd Davis was cast as Arthur Hart. They appeared on the 1950s-themed episode, wherein Wanda and her husband Vision had to host the Harts for an impromptu dinner party, in order for Vision to receive a promotion from Mr. Hart. During the dinner, the Harts kept pressing the newly wed couple for background on their relationship, which caused Wanda to start choking Mr. Hart, while Mrs. Hart could only keep smiling and repeatedly saying "stop it." Despite this, Vision saved Mr. Hart at the command of Wanda and got the promotion. Mrs. Hart was also in the 1960s-themed episode, attending the Westview talent show in the town square. Eventually, the witch Agatha Harkness released all the citizens of Westview from Wanda's spell, which led to Wanda taking down her spell over Westview and departing before law enforcement arrived. Three years later, Sharon was now living alone, given that Todd had passed away. One day, while working on her garden, Sharon was approached by a recently freed Agatha who tricks her into joining her coven as a substitute for a necessary Green Witch by telling her she was hosting a party at her house. The coven enter the Witches' Road, just in time to escape from the Salem Seven.

sharon donavan.name: Sharon Donavan
sharon donavan.first_appearance: Target Presents: Reading to the Rescue! Vol 1 1
sharon donavan.origin: Sharon Donavan is an elementary school student living in New York City who loves to sing and dance. Using the power of reading, her and her friends, Russ Chiang and Austin Burns, have helped the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and Spider-Man defeat Loki, Impossible Man, and Kang in the past. In one notable instance, Sharon briefly bonded with the Enigma Force to become the hero Serenity, gaining empathic powers. Using these abilities, she was able to subdue a rampaging Annihilus before the Enigma Force departed.

sharon friedlander.name: Sharon Friedlander
sharon friedlander.species: Human magically transformed to resemble a Cheyenne.
sharon friedlander.origin: Sharon was working as a nurse when she was caught up in a battle between the New Mutants and the Demon Bear. She and Tom Corsi were magically transformed from being physically Caucasian to Native American. Unable to explain their new bodies, Sharon and Tom resided at the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters and joined the school staff. Sharon acted as the school nurse. After the Mansion was destroyed during "Inferno", Sharon and Tom relocated to Muir Island and assisted Moira MacTaggert. They participated in the defense of the Research Center from an assault by the Reavers. Much later, Sharon and Tom went undercover at a private school to supervise a latent mutant. When the Acolytes attacked the school in search of the youth, Sharon then sent a desperate S.O.S. to the X-Men. Her allies received the message and came to her aid, but the Acolyte Joanna Cargill had already killed Sharon.

sharon ginsberg.name: Sharon Ginsberg
sharon ginsberg.origin: Sharon Ginsberg began as Solomon O'Sullivan's lawyer, but she was also secretly a winged mutant. Afraid, she did not make her mutation public, and was kept under Solomon's thumb, doing his legal dirty work for him, including repeated attempts to prevent Venus Dee Milo, whom Solomon managed, from joining X-Statix. Sharon appeared to be more hard-line in her position on this issue than Solomon, berating him publicly when he signed Venus over to Spike Freeman. She later returned, however, to save Solomon from a mob of angry O-Force fans, revealing her wings in the process. Upon the appearance of Bad Guy, an evil alien impersonating Guy Smith, Solomon and Sharon sought to enlist his aid in ruining X-Statix's image. Sharon's attempt at negotiating ended with her wings being pulled off and Sharon rendered unconscious from the pain. Solomon rushed her to X-Statix, where she was placed under the care of Doctor Swaine. Awakening from her unconscious state, Sharon's mind snapped upon realizing she was now without her wings. Manifesting claws, Sharon eviscerated Solomon, then went after X-Statix on the set of their upcoming movie. In her warped mind, she believed them responsible for outing her powers and then taking them away. Before she could do any real damage, however, she was knocked out by one of the film actors, Robbie Rodriguez, who revealed himself as a mutant, and captured by X-Statix.

sharon kelly.name: Sharon Kelly
sharon kelly.origin: Sharon Kelly was a former waitress at the Hellfire Club in New York who met Senator Robert Kelly while working there after being introduced to Kelly by her employer Sebastian Shaw and subsequently married him. The newlywed Sharon visited the Hellfire Club with her husband, who was being entertained by its Black King, Shaw, to discuss funding for the Sentinel Program. Sharon dressed up in her raunchy former uniform to surprise her husband while the two men were dining. After leaving the club, the Kellys' limousine was struck by Rogue (who was being controlled by her Carol Danvers personality at the time), who had been struck in battle against the Master Mold. Sharon pulled her unconscious husband away from the limo wreckage, and then bravely went back for Carol. However, Sharon was struck by an energy blast and killed. The already mutant-hating senator blamed the X-Men for his wife's death.

After leaving the club, the Kellys' limousine was struck by Rogue (who was being controlled by her Carol Danvers personality at the time), who had been struck in battle against the Master Mold. Sharon pulled her unconscious husband away from the limo wreckage, and then bravely went back for Carol. However, Sharon was struck by an energy blast and killed. The already mutant-hating senator blamed the X-Men for his wife's death.
